Description: Shackles the target undead enemy for up to 30 sec. The shackled unit is unable to move, attack or cast spells.  Any damage caused will release the target.      Only one target can be shackled at a time.

Name: Absolution
Description: Reduces the mana cost of your Dispel Magic, Cure Disease, Abolish Disease and Mass Dispel spells by 15%.

Name: Aspiration
Description: Reduces the cooldown of your Inner Focus, Power Infusion, Pain Suppression, Leap of Faith and Penance spells by 20%.     Increases the duration of Pain Suppression by 2 sec.

Name: Borrowed Time
Description: Grants 20% spell haste for 6 sec after casting Power Word: Shield. This effect is consumed by your next non-instant spell.     Increases the healing power scaling of your Power Word: Shield by 40%.

Name: Divine Aegis
Description: Your effective critical healing creates a protective barrier absorbing damage up to 15% of the healed amount for 6 sec.    Divine Aegis is doubled for single target heals.    The absorb from Divine Aegis is limited to 10% of the target's maximum health.

Name: Enlightenment
Description: Increases your total Spirit, Intellect and haste by 3%.

Name: Focused Power
Description: Increases all damage and healing done by 4%.     The cast time of Mass dispel is reduced 1 sec.

Name: Focused Will
Description: Increases your spell critical effect chance by 3%,  Capstone Bonus: Gain the Focused Will effect whenever you take a critical hit, increasing healing taken by 5% and decreasing damage taken by 4%. This effect stacks up to 3 times and lasts 10 seconds.

Name: Grace
Description: Your Direct Heals and Power Word: Shield grant Grace, increasing the target's healing received from you by 3% for 12 sec. Stacks up to 3 times and can only affect one target.

Name: Improved Flash Heal
Description: Reduces the mana cost of your Flash Heal by 10%, and increases the critical effect chance of your Flash Heal by 15% on friendly targets at or below 50% health.  Capstone Bonus: Flash Heal casts reduce the cooldown of Inner Focus by 2 seconds.

Name: Improved Inner Fire
Description: Increases the effect of your Inner Fire spell by 45%, and increases the total number of charges by 12.

Name: Improved Mana Burn
Description: Reduces the casting time of your Mana Burn spell by 1 sec.

Name: Improved Power Word: Fortitude
Description: Increases your total Stamina by 4%.    Increases the effect of your Power Word: Fortitude and Prayer of Fortitude spells by 30%.

Name: Improved Power Word: Shield
Description: Increases the damage absorbed by your Power Word: Shield by 15%.

Name: Martyrdom
Description: You gain Focused Casting after being hit by a melee or ranged critical strike.     Focused Casting reduces the pushback suffered from damaging attacks while casting Priest spells by 100% and decreases the duration of Interrupt effects by 20%. Lasts 6 sec.

Name: Meditation
Description: Allows 25% of your mana regeneration to continue while casting.  Capstone Bonus: Your spell critical strike rating is increased by 10% of your Spirit.

Name: Mental Agility
Description: Reduces the mana cost of your instant cast spells by 10%.

Name: Mental Strength
Description: Increases your total Intellect by 10%.    Reduces all magic damage taken by 3%.

Name: Rapture
Description: When your Power Word: Shield is completely absorbed or dispelled you are instantly energized with 2.5% of your total mana.    You have a 100% chance to energize your shielded target with 2% total mana, 8 rage and 16 energy. This effect can only occur once every 12 sec.

Name: Reflective Shield
Description: Causes 44% of the damage you absorb with Power Word: Shield to reflect back at the attacker.  This damage causes no threat.

Name: Renewed Hope
Description: Increases the critical effect chance of your Holy spells by 6% on targets afflicted by the Weakened Soul effect.    You have a 100% chance to reduce all damage taken by 3% for 1 min to all friendly party and raid targets when you cast Power Word: Shield. This effect has a 15 sec cooldown.

Name: Silent Resolve
Description: Reduces the threat generated by your Holy and Discipline spells by 20% and reduces the chance your helpful spells and damage over time effects will be dispelled by 30%.

Name: Soul Warding
Description: Reduces the cooldown of your Power Word: Shield ability by 4 sec, and reduces the mana cost of your Power Word: Shield by 15%.

Name: Twin Disciplines
Description: Increases the damage and healing done by your Holy spells and abilities by 5%, and their critical strike chance by 5%.

Name: Unbreakable Will
Description: Reduces the duration of Stun, Fear, and Silence effects done to you by an additional 30%.  This does not stack with other Stun or Fear reduction effects.

Name: Abolish Disease
Description: Attempts to cure 1 disease effect on the target, and 1 more disease effect every 3 seconds for 12 sec.

Name: Binding Heal
Description: Heals a friendly target and the caster for 359 to 418. Low threat.

Name: Circle of Healing
Description: Heals up to 5 friendly party or raid members within 15 yards of the target for 151 to 173.

Name: Cure Disease
Description: Removes 1 disease from the friendly target.

Name: Desperate Prayer
Description: Heals you for 110 to 150. If used while below 50% health, it guarantees a critical heal.

Name: Divine Hymn
Description: Heals 3 nearby lowest health friendly party or raid targets within 40 yards for 896 to 984 every 2 sec for 8 sec, and increases healing done to them by 10% for 8 sec. Maximum of 12 heals. The Priest must channel to maintain the spell.

Name: Divine Star
Description: Fires a Divine Star in front of you, traveling 30 yards, healing all allies within 5 yards of its path for 23.  After reaching its destination it will return to its original position, also healing all allies in its path.

Name: Flash Heal
Description: Heals a friendly target for 121 to 146.

Name: Greater Heal
Description: A slow casting spell that heals a single target for 31 to 38.

Name: Guardian Spirit
Description: Calls upon a guardian spirit to watch over the friendly target. The spirit increases the healing received by the target by 40%, and also prevents the target from dying by sacrificing itself, only up to a maximum of 15% of target's total health. This sacrifice terminates the effect but heals the target of 50% of their maximum health. Lasts 10 sec.

Name: Halo
Description: Creates a ring of Holy energy around you that quickly expands and grows in power, healing raid and party members up to 30 yds away. Heals with greater effect the further away the ally is. Also increases the Holy healing taken from the caster by 8%.

Name: Holy Fire
Description: Consumes the enemy in holy flames that cause 81 to 97 Holy damage and an additional 21 Holy damage over 7 sec.

Name: Holy Nova
Description: Causes an explosion of holy light around the caster, causing 21 to 23 Holy damage to all enemy targets within 10 yards and healing all party members within 10 yards for 52 to 60. These effects cause no threat.

Name: Hymn of Hope
Description: Restores 3% mana to 3 nearby low mana friendly party or raid targets every 2 sec for 8 sec, and increases their total maximum mana by 20% for 8 sec. Maximum of 12 mana restores. The Priest must channel to maintain the spell.

Name: Leap of Faith
Description: Pulls the spirit of a party or raid member, moving them to you. The same target can only be affected by this once every 30 seconds.

Name: Lightwell
Description: Creates a Holy Lightwell.    Lightwell will attempt to heal a nearby party or raid member within 20 yards every second if they have less than 50% health for 11.    Lightwell lasts for 30 seconds or until it heals 10 times.

Name: Prayer of Healing
Description: A powerful prayer heals the friendly target's party members within 30 yards for 118 to 130.

Name: Prayer of Mending
Description: Places a spell on the target that heals them for 101 the next time they take damage.  When the heal occurs, Prayer of Mending jumps to a party or raid member within 20 yards. Jumps up to 5 times and lasts 30 sec after each jump.      This spell can only be placed on one target at a time.

Name: Priest Cleansing Mastery
Description: You gain Priest Cleansing Mastery when learning any Priest Cleansing Spell.     This Mastery automatically unlocks additional Priest Cleansing Spells when you reach their Class Point requirements at no additional ability essence cost.   Cure Disease Removes 1 diseases from the friendly target.   Abolish Disease Attempts to cure 1 disease effect on the target, and more disease effects over time.

Name: Priest Healing Mastery
Description: You gain Priest Healing Mastery when learning any Priest Healing Spell.     This Mastery automatically unlocks additional Priest Healing Spells when you reach their Class Point requirements at no additional ability essence cost.    Greater Heal A slow casting spell that heals a single target.   Flash Heal Heals a friendly target.

Name: Renew
Description: Heals the target for 35 over 15 sec.

Name: Resurrection
Description: Brings a dead player back to life with 70 health and 135 mana.  Cannot be cast when in combat.

Name: Smite
Description: Smite an enemy for 13 to 17 Holy damage.

Name: Answered Prayers
Description: Increases all damage done by 10% and all healing done by 10%.    Increases Holy damage by an additional 5%.

Name: Blessed Recovery
Description: After being struck by a critical strike, you heal for 15% of the damage taken over 6 sec, additional critical strikes taken during the effect increase the healing received.  Capstone Bonus: When Blessed Recovery is active, your Desperate Prayer will come off cooldown three times as fast.

Name: Blessed Resilience
Description: Increases the effectiveness of your healing spells by 3%, and critical hits made against you have a 60% chance to prevent you from being critically hit again for 6 sec.

Name: Body and Soul
Description: When you cast Power Word: Shield or Leap of Faith, you increase the target's movement speed by 60% for 4 sec,    You have a 100% chance when you cast Abolish Disease on yourself to also cleanse 1 poison effect in addition to diseases.

Name: Divine Fury
Description: Increases the critical strike chance of Holy Fire by 6%.     You deal 6% increased damage against targets afflicted by your Holy Fire.

Name: Divine Providence
Description: Increases the amount healed Holy Spells by 10%.     Reduces the cooldown of your Halo and Prayer of Mending by 30%.

Name: Empowered Healing
Description: Your Greater Heal, Flash Heal, Binding Heal, and Divine Star spells gain an additional 25% of your bonus healing effects.

Name: Empowered Renew
Description: Your Renew spell gains another 15% of your bonus healing effects.  Your Renew instantly heals the target for 15% of the total periodic effect.

Name: Healing Focus
Description: Increases your haste by 2%.    Reduces the pushback suffered from damaging attacks while casting by 70%.

Name: Healing Prayers
Description: Reduces the mana cost of your Prayer of Healing, Prayer of Mending and Halo spell by 20% .    Increases the critical strike chance of your Prayer of Healing and Halo spell by 10%.

Name: Holy Concentration
Description: Your Spirit is increased by 30% for 12 sec after you critically heal with Flash Heal, Greater Heal, or Binding Heal, or critically hit with Holy Fire or Smite.     Greater Heal, Flash Heal, Binding Heal, and Circle of Healing have a 100% chance to extend the duration of your Renew on all nearby party and raid members by 3 sec, up to an additional 6 sec.     This does not stack with similar effects.

Name: Holy Focus
Description: Your spell critical strikes now deal 200% damage.     This does not stack with other similar effects.   Capstone Bonus: Your Holy damaging spell critical strikes have a 50% chance to increase magic damage done by 5% for 6 seconds.     This effect can only occur once every 8 seconds.

Name: Holy Reach
Description: Increases the range of your damaging spells with a channeling or cast time by 6 yards.     This does not stack with other similar effects.    Increases the radius of your Prayer of Healing, Holy Nova, Divine Hymn, and Circle of Healing spells by 20%.   Capstone Bonus: Directly healing or directly damaging a target further than 20 yards away from you has a 20% chance to restore 2% of your missing mana over 4 sec. This effect can only occur once every 15 sec.

Name: Holy Specialization
Description: Increases your chance to get a critical strike with all Holy spells and abilities by 5%.

Name: Improved Divine Star
Description: Increases your critical strike chance by 3%.    Increases the amount healed by your Divine Star spell by 30%.

Name: Improved Healing
Description: Reduces the mana cost of your Greater Heal, Divine Hymn and Penance spells by 15%.

Name: Improved Renew
Description: Increases the amount healed by your Renew spell by 15%.

Name: Inspiration
Description: Reduces your target's Physical damage taken by 10% for 15 sec after getting a critical effect from one of your healing spells.   Does not stack with other similar effects.

Name: Radiant Fury
Description: Your Smite, Holy Fire and the damage of Holy Nova gains an additional 20% of your bonus spell damage effects.    Duration of Holy Fire is increased by 2.5 sec.

Name: Searing Light
Description: Increases the damage of your Smite, Holy Fire, Penance, Holy Nova, Holy Shock and Exorcism spells by 15%.    Reduces the mana cost of your Holy Nova by 25%.

Name: Serendipity
Description: When you heal with Binding Heal or Flash Heal, cast Renew, or deal damage with Smite, the cast time and mana cost of your next Greater Heal or Prayer of Healing spell is reduced by 15%. Stacks up to 3 times. Lasts 20 sec.

Name: Spell Warding
Description: Reduces all magic damage taken by 10%.

Name: Spirit of Redemption
Description: Increases total Spirit by 5% and upon death, you becomes the Spirit of Redemption for 15 sec.      The Spirit of Redemption cannot move, attack, be attacked or targeted by any spells or effects.  While in this form you can cast any healing spell free of cost.  When the effect ends, you die.

Name: Spiritual Guidance
Description: Increases spell power by 25% of your total Spirit.

Name: Spiritual Healing
Description: Increases the amount healed by your spells by 10%.

Name: Surge of Light
Description: Your direct damage and healing spell and ability criticals have a 50% chance to cause your next Smite or Flash Heal spell to be instant cast and cost no mana but are incapable of a critical hit. This effect lasts 10 sec.

Name: Test of Faith
Description: Increases healing and damage done to targets below 50% health by 12%.

Name: Devouring Plague
Description: Afflicts the target with a disease that causes 152 Shadow damage over 24 sec. 15% of damage caused by the Devouring Plague heals the caster. This spell can only affect one target at a time.

Name: Dispersion
Description: You disperse into pure Shadow energy, reducing all damage taken by 90%.  You are unable to attack or cast spells, but you regenerate 6% mana every 1 sec for 6 sec. Dispersion can be cast while stunned, feared or silenced and clears all snare and movement impairing effects when cast.

Name: Fade
Description: Fade out, temporarily reducing all your threat for 10 sec.  This ability is usable while shapeshifted.

Name: Mind Blast
Description: Blasts the target for 39 to 43 Shadow damage.

Name: Mind Flay
Description: Assault the target's mind with Shadow energy, causing 45 Shadow damage over 3 sec and slowing their movement speed by 50%.

Name: Mind Sear
Description: Causes an explosion of shadow magic around the enemy target, causing 50 to 57 Shadow damage every 1 sec for 5 sec to all enemies within 10 yards around the target.

Name: Mind Soothe
Description: Soothes the target, reducing the range at which it will attack you by 10 yards. Only affects Humanoid targets. Lasts 15 sec.

Name: Mind Vision
Description: Allows the caster to see through the target's eyes for 1 min.  This ability is usable while shapeshifted.

Name: Psychic Horror
Description: You terrify the target, causing them to tremble in horror for 3 sec, and disarming their main hand and ranged weapons for 10 sec.  This spell cannot miss.

Name: Psychic Scream
Description: The caster lets out a psychic scream, causing 2 enemies within 8 yards to flee for 6 sec.  Damage caused may interrupt the effect.

Name: Shadow Protection
Description: Increases the target's resistance to Shadow spells by 30 for 30 min.

Name: Shadow Word: Death
Description: A word of dark binding that inflicts 192 to 222 Shadow damage to the target.  If the target is not killed by Shadow Word: Death, the caster takes damage equal to the damage inflicted upon the target after a short delay.

Name: Shadow Word: Pain
Description: A word of darkness that causes 30 Shadow damage over 18 sec.

Name: Shadowfiend
Description: Creates a shadowy fiend to attack the target.  Caster receives 5% mana when the Shadowfiend attacks. Damage taken by area of effect attacks is reduced. Lasts 15 sec.

Name: Shadowform
Description: Assume a Shadowform, increasing your Shadow damage by 15%.    You may not cast Healing or Priest Holy spells while in this form except for Cure Disease and Abolish Disease.    Grants the periodic damage from your Shadow Word: Pain, Devouring Plague, and Vampiric Touch spells the ability to critically hit and benefit from haste.

Name: Silence
Description: Silences the target, preventing them from casting spells for 5 sec. Non-player victim spellcasting is also interrupted for 3 sec.

Name: Vampiric Embrace
Description: Fills you with the embrace of Shadow energy, causing you to be healed for 15% and other party members to be healed for 3% of any single-target Priest Shadow spell damage you deal.     Either heal cannot exceed 5% of the maximum health of the caster.   This ability is usable while shapeshifted.

Name: Vampiric Touch
Description: Causes 340 Shadow damage over 15 sec to your target.     When you deal damage with Mind Blast to a target afflicted by your Vampiric Touch, you gain Replenishment.    If Vampiric Touch is dispelled it will cause 544 damage to the afflicted target.     Replenishment Replenishes 1% of maximum mana per 5 sec on up to 10 party members for 15 sec.

Name: Void Eruption
Description: Releases an explosive blast of pure void energy, causing Shadow damage to up to 10 enemies within 10 yards of your target. The power drawn from the Void increases your periodic Shadow Priest damage by 20% for 5 sec, increased by 0.5 sec for each enemy hit.  While in Shadowform this spell also applies Shadow Word: Pain (if known) to all enemies hit.

Name: Void Shift
Description: You and the currently targeted party or raid member swap health percentages. Increases the health percentage of you and your ally to 25% if below that amount.  After casting or being targeted by Void Shift you cannot cast or be targeted by it for 1 min.

Name: Darkness
Description: Increases all damage done by 3%.    Increases your Shadow damage done by 3%.

Name: Improved Devouring Plague
Description: Increases the periodic damage done by your Devouring Plague by 15%.    Devouring Plague now instantly deals 30% of its total periodic effect when cast.  You deal 3% increased damage against targets afflicted by your Devouring Plague.

Name: Improved Mind Blast
Description: Reduces the cooldown of your Mind Blast spell by 2.5 sec.    Mind Blast also has a 100% chance to reduce all healing done to the target by 20% for 10 sec.

Name: Improved Psychic Scream
Description: Reduces the cooldown of your Psychic Scream spell by 4 sec.

Name: Improved Shadow Word: Pain
Description: Increases the damage of your Shadow Word: Pain spell by 6%.

Name: Improved Shadowform
Description: Your Fade has a 100% chance to clear all movement impairing effects when used in Shadowform.  While in Shadowform, you also take 15% less damage and lose 70% less casting or channeling time when hit while casting Shadow spells

Name: Improved Spirit Tap
Description: Your Spirit Tap now also triggers from your critical strikes with direct damage Shadow spells and Mind Flay and now also increases critical strike rating by 10% of your Spirit.

Name: Improved Vampiric Embrace
Description: Increases the healing received from Vampiric Embrace by 67%.

Name: Mind Melt
Description: Increases the critical strike chance of your Mind Blast, Shadow Word: Death, Mind Flay and Mind Sear spells by 4%.    Increases the periodic critical strike chance of your damaging periodic spells by 6%.

Name: Misery
Description: Your Mind Blast, Mind Flay and Mind Sear gain an additional 15% of your bonus spell damage effects.    Your Shadow Word: Pain, Mind Flay and Vampiric Touch spells increase the chance for harmful spells to hit by 3% lasting 24 sec.

Name: Pain and Suffering
Description: Shadow channeled spells and Mind Blast casts have a 100% chance to refresh the duration of your Shadow Word: Pain on the target.    Reduces the damage you take from your own Shadow Word: Death by 30%.

Name: Shadow Affinity
Description: Reduces the mana cost of your Shadow spells by 6%.    You receive 15% of your base mana when your Shadow Word: Pain or Vampiric Touch spells are dispelled.  Capstone Bonus: All threat generated is reduced by 30%. This capstone effect does not stack with similar capstone effects.

Name: Shadow Focus
Description: Reduces the mana cost of your spells by 6%.    Reduces spell pushback suffered from damaging attacks by 70%.

Name: Shadow Power
Description: Your spell critical strikes now deal 200% damage.     This does not stack with other similar effects.   Capstone Bonus: Your Shadow and Holy periodic damage effects have a 30% chance to make the target vulnerable to your power, increasing their Magic damage taken from you by 4% for 4 seconds.

Name: Shadow Reach
Description: Increases the range of your damaging spells with a channeling or cast time by 6 yards.     This does not stack with other similar effects.  Dealing direct magic damage to a target further than 20 yards away from you has a 33% chance to corrupt their soul, dealing Shadow damage over 3 seconds. This effect can only occur once every 15 sec.

Name: Shadow Weaving
Description: Your damaging Priest Shadow spells have a 100% chance to increase the Shadow damage you deal by 2% for 15 sec.  Stacks up to 5 times.

Name: Spirit Tap
Description: You have a 100% chance to gain Spirit Tap after killing a target that yields experience or honor.     Your Spirit is increased by 30% and your mana will regenerate at 75% rate while casting.   Lasts 15 sec.  This does not stack with similar effects.

Name: Twisted Faith
Description: Increases your spell power by 20% of your total Spirit.    Increases the damage done by your Mind Flay and Mind Blast is increased by 10% if your target is afflicted by your Shadow Word: Pain.

Name: Veiled Shadows
Description: Reduces the cooldown of your Shadowfiend ability by 120 sec and of your Fade ability by 6 sec.

Name: Void-touched Mind
Description: Mind Blast, Mind Flay and Mind Sear spells cost 15% less mana.  Capstone Bonus: Your Mind Blast extends the duration of Void Eruption by up to 3 seconds and your Mind Flay ticks increase the periodic damage increase of Void Eruption by an additional 3%, stacks up to 10 times.

Name: Advanced Finishing Move Mastery
Description: You gain Advanced Finishing Move Mastery when learning any Advanced Finishing Move Spell.     This Mastery automatically unlocks additional Advanced Finishing Move Spells when you reach their Class Point requirements at no additional ability essence cost.                               Recuperate Finishing move that consumes combo points on your target to restore health over time. Lasts longer per combo point:    Slice and Dice Finishing move that increases your melee attack speed. Lasts longer per combo point.   Meditate Finishing move that consumes combo points on any nearby target to restores mana over time. Lasts longer per combo point.   Expose Armor Finishing move that exposes the target, reducing their armor and lasts longer per combo point.   Kidney Shot Finishing move that stuns the target.  Lasts longer per combo point.

Name: Ambush
Description: Ambush the target, causing 275% weapon damage plus 77 to the target. Must be stealthed and behind the target. Requires a dagger in the main hand. Awards 2 combo points.

Name: Cheap Shot
Description: Stuns the target for 4 sec. Must be stealthed. Awards 2 combo points.

Name: Cold Blood
Description: When activated, your next direct damage Rogue ability has 100% increased critical strike chance, 20% increased damage (10% versus players) and is usable from 10 yards.     When consumed you will gain 4% melee and ranged critical strike chance for 15 sec.

Name: Combat Readiness
Description: Enter a state of heightened defensive awareness. Each time you're hit by a spell or ability, your overall damage taken is reduced by 5%(3% versus players) for 10 sec. Stacks up to 5 times. Lasts 20 sec or until you have not been attacked for 10 sec.  This ability is usable while shapeshifted.

Name: Combo Mastery
Description: You gain Combo Mastery when learning any Rogue Combo Generator.     This Mastery automatically unlocks additional Rogue Combo Generators when you reach their Class Point requirements at no additional ability essence cost.   Sinister Strike Strikes the enemy with your weapon. Awards 1 combo point.   Backstab Backstab the target, causing physical damage and wards 1 combo point. Must be behind target.    Hemorrhage Strikes the target, dealing physical damage, causing them to hemmorage, taking increased physical damage while active. Awards 1 combo point.    Mutilate Strikes the target with both weapons. Awards 2 Combo points.

Name: Crimson Tempest
Description: Finishing move that slashes at the flesh of all enemies within 8 yards, dealing Physical damage and causing them to bleed per combo point:     1 point: 9 damage and 17 damage over 8 sec     2 points: 16 damage and 25 damage over 8 sec     3 points: 23 damage and 33 damage over 8 sec     4 points: 30 damage and 42 damage over 8 sec     5 points: 38 damage and 51 damage over 8 sec

Name: Deadly Throw
Description: Finishing move that reduces the movement of the target by 50% for 6 sec and causes increased thrown weapon damage:     1 point  : 28-44 damage     2 points: 47-63 damage     3 points: 66-82 damage     4 points: 85-101 damage     5 points: 104-120 damage

Name: Dismantle
Description: Disarm the enemy, removing their weapons, shields, or other equipment carried for 6 sec.

Name: Envenom
Description: Finishing move that consumes your Deadly Poison doses on the target and deals instant poison damage.     After the Envenom attack you have an additional 15% chance to apply Deadly Poison and a 75% increased frequency of applying Instant Poison for 1 sec plus an additional 1 sec per combo point.  One dose is consumed for each combo point:    1 dose:  38 damage    2 doses: 77 damage    3 doses: 116 damage    4 doses: 156 damage    5 doses: 196 damage

Name: Essential Finishing Move Mastery
Description: You gain Essential Finishing Move Mastery when learning any Essential Rogue Finishing Move.     This Mastery automatically unlocks additional Essential Rogue Finishing Move when you reach their Class Point requirements at no additional ability essence cost.    Eviscerate Finishing move that causes Physical damage. Damage increases per combo point.   Crimson Tempest Finishing move that slashes at the flesh of all enemies around you, dealing Physical damage and causing them to bleed, duration is increased per combo point.   Rupture Finishing move that causes damage over time. Lasts longer per combo point.    Deadly Throw Finishing move that reduces the movement of the target and causes increased thrown weapon damage per combo point.    Envenom Finishing move that consumes your Deadly Poison doses on the target and deals instant poison damage.

Name: Eviscerate
Description: Finishing move that causes damage per combo point:     1 point  : 7-11 damage     2 points: 13-17 damage     3 points: 19-23 damage     4 points: 26-30 damage     5 points: 33-37 damage

Name: Expose Armor
Description: Finishing move that exposes the target, reducing armor by 20% and lasting longer per combo point:    1 point  : 6 sec.    2 points: 12 sec.    3 points: 18 sec.    4 points: 24 sec.    5 points: 30 sec.   Does not stack with other similar effects.

Name: Garrote
Description: When attacking from stealth, inflicts 18 damage to an enemy every 3 sec. for 18 sec and silences the enemy for 2 sec. Awards 1 combo point.

Name: Hunger For Blood
Description: Enrages you, increasing all Physical and Nature damage caused by 10%, lasting for 15 seconds. Also gives you a movement boost of 30% for 5 seconds. Requires any bleed to be active on the target to be used.   This ability is usable while shapeshifted.

Name: Kidney Shot
Description: Finishing move that stuns the target.  Lasts longer per combo point:    1 point  : 1 second    2 points: 2 seconds    3 points: 3 seconds    4 points: 4 seconds    5 points: 5 seconds

Name: Meditate
Description: Finishing move that consumes combo points on any nearby target to restore 6% of your base mana every 2 sec. Lasts longer per combo point:    1 point  : 18% base mana over 6  secs    2 points: 36% base mana over 12  secs     3 points: 54% base mana over 18  secs    4 points: 72% base mana over 24  secs    5 points: 90% base mana over 30 secs

Name: Mutilate
Description: Instantly attacks with both weapons for 100% weapon damage plus an additional 36 with each weapon. Awards 2 combo points.    Damage is increased by 20% against Poisoned targets.

Name: Poison Mastery
Description: You gain Poison Mastery when learning any Rogue Poison.     This Mastery automatically unlocks additional Essential Rogue Poisons when you reach their Class Point requirements at no additional ability essence cost.   Instant Poison Coats a melee or ranged weapon with a poison that deals nature damage.    Crippling Poison Coats a weapon with crippling poison that slows the target.   Mind-numbing Poison Coats a weapon with mind-numbing poison that reduces their casting speed.   Deadly Poison Coats your weapon with a deadly poison that causes your targets to take Nature damage over times and stacks up.    Wound Poison Coats your weapon with a poison that deals Nature damage and reduces the target's healing received.    Anesthetic Poison Coats your weapon with poison that deals Nature damage and dispels Enrage effects on your target.

Name: Rupture
Description: Finishing move that causes damage over time.  Lasts longer per combo point:     1 point  : 40 damage over 8 sec     2 points: 61 damage over 10 sec     3 points: 87 damage over 12 sec     4 points: 117 damage over 14 sec     5 points: 153 damage over 16 sec

Name: Slice and Dice
Description: Finishing move that increases melee attack speed by 20%. Lasts longer per combo point:     1 point  : 9 seconds     2 points: 12 seconds     3 points: 15 seconds     4 points: 18 seconds     5 points: 21 seconds    This ability is usable while shapeshifted.

Name: Smoke Bomb
Description: Creates a cloud of thick smoke in an 8 yard radius around you for 5 sec. Enemies are unable to target into or out of the smoke cloud.   This ability is usable while shapeshifted.

Name: Stealth Mastery
Description: You gain Assasination Mastery when learning any Rogue Opening Move.     This Mastery automatically unlocks additional Essential Stealth Opening Moves when you reach their Class Point requirements at no additional ability essence cost.     Stealth Allows you to sneak around, but reduces your speed by 30%. Removes invulnerabilities when used. Lasts until cancelled.   Garrote Causes enemy to bleed, taking damage over time, if used from stealth also silences the target. Awards 1 combo point.   Ambush Ambuses the target, dealing physical damage to the target. Must be stealthed and behind the target. Requires a dagger in the mainhand. Awards 2 combo points.   Cheap Shot Stuns the target for until cancelled. Must be stealthed. Awards 2 combo points.

Name: Blood Spatter
Description: Increases the damage caused by your Garrote, Rupture and Crimson Tempest abilities by 30%.    Increases the damage of your Hemorrhage ability by 10%.

Name: Cut to the Chase
Description: Your Eviscerate, Envenom, and Ferocious Bite abilities have a 100% chance to refresh your Slice and Dice duration to its 5 combo point maximum.

Name: Deadened Nerves
Description: Reduces all damage taken by 6%.

Name: Deadly Brew
Description: When you apply Instant, Deadly or Mind-Numbing poison to a target, you have a 100% chance to apply Crippling poison.     This effect can only occur once every 1 seconds.

Name: Find Weakness
Description: Increases your critical strike chance by 6%.    Capstone Bonus: The periodic damage of your Garrote is able to critically hit.

Name: Fleet Footed
Description: Reduces the duration of all movement impairing effects by 30% and increases your movement speed by 15%.  This does not stack with other movement speed increasing effects.

Name: Focused Attacks
Description: Critical strikes with melee auto attacks, offensive spells and abilities have a 100% chance to give you 2 energy.

Name: Improved Eviscerate
Description: Increases the damage of your Eviscerate ability by 20%.

Name: Improved Expose Armor
Description: Reduces the energy cost of your Expose Armor ability by 10, increases its duration by 50%, and your attacks ignore an additional 12% of your target's armor.

Name: Improved Kidney Shot
Description: Kidney Shot increases damage taken by the target from all sources by 8%.

Name: Improved Poisons
Description: Increases the chance to apply Deadly Poison to your target by 20% and the frequency of applying Instant Poison to your target by 50%.

Name: Lethality
Description: Increases the critical strike damage bonus of all non-periodic combo point-generating Rogue abilities and Rogue poisons by 30%.

Name: Malice
Description: Increases your chance to get a critical strike with all spells and attacks by 5%.  Capstone Bonus: You gain 5 Energy when your Garrote, Rupture or Crimson Tempest deal damage.

Name: Master Poisoner
Description: Increases the critical strike chance of all spells and attacks against any target you have poisoned by 3%.    Reduces the duration of all Poison effects applied to you by 50%.    Envenom has a 100% chance not to consume Deadly Poison.   Does not stack with other similar effects.

Name: Murder
Description: Increases all damage done by 2%     Increases the duration of the Silence effect from Garrote by 0.5 sec.

Name: Overkill
Description: While stealthed, and for 20 sec seconds after breaking stealth, you regenerate 30% additional energy.

Name: Puncturing Wounds
Description: Increases the critical strike chance of your Backstab ability by 30%.    Increases the critical strike chance of your Mutilate ability by 15%.

Name: Quick Recovery
Description: Increases healing done to you by 20%.   This effect does not stack with other similar effects.   Your Rogue finishing moves refund 80% of their Energy cost when they fail to hit.

Name: Remorseless Attacks
Description: After killing an opponent that yields experience or honor, gives you a 40% increased critical strike chance on your next Sinister Strike, Hemorrhage, Backstab, Mutilate, Ambush, or Ghostly Strike.  Lasts 20 sec.  Capstone Bonus: Triggering Remorseless Attacks also refreshes your Slice and Dice duration to its 5 combo point maximum.

Name: Ruthlessness
Description: Increases the damage of your Rogue finishing moves by 6%.     Your Rogue melee finishing moves have a 60% chance to add a combo point.    This effect cannot occur more than once every 2 seconds.

Name: Seal Fate
Description: Your critical strikes from Rogue abilities that add combo points have a 100% chance to add an additional combo point.     Increases the damage done by Eviscerate, Rupture, Deadly Throw and Crimson Tempest by 10%.  Capstone Bonus: Consuming Cold Blood with a finishing move has a 20% chance per combo point to increase your movement speed by 70% for 4 sec.

Name: Turn the Tables
Description: Whenever anyone in your party or raid blocks, dodges, or parries an attack your chance to critically hit with combo point generators and haste is increased by 6% for 8 sec.

Name: Vigor
Description: Increases your maximum Energy by 20.

Name: Vile Poisons
Description: Increases the damage dealt by your poisons and Envenom ability by 20%.    Gives your damage over time poisons an additional 30% chance to resist dispel effects.

Name: Adrenaline Rush
Description: Increases your Energy regeneration rate by 100% for 15 sec.  This ability is usable while shapeshifted.

Name: Backstab
Description: Backstab the target, causing 150% weapon damage plus 10 to the target. Must be behind the target.  Requires a dagger in the main hand. Awards 1 combo point.

Name: Blade Flurry
Description: Increases your melee attack speed by 20%. In addition, attacks strike an additional nearby opponent. Lasts 20 sec.    Can't be active at the same time as Sweeping Strikes.     This ability is usable while shapeshifted.

Name: Evasion
Description: Increases your dodge chance by 50% and reduces the chance ranged attacks hit you by 50%. Lasts 15 sec.     This ability is usable while shapeshifted.

Name: Fan of Knives
Description: Instantly throw both weapons at all targets within 8 yards, causing 105% weapon damage with daggers, and 70% weapon damage with all other weapons.

Name: Feint
Description: Performs a feint, causing no damage but lowering your threat by a large amount, making the enemy less likely to attack you.  In addition, reduces the damage you take from area of effect attacks by 20% for 6 sec.

Name: Gouge
Description: Causes 4 damage, incapacitating the opponent for 4 sec, and turns off your attack.  Target must be facing you.  Any damage caused will revive the target. Awards 1 combo point.

Name: Grappling Hook
Description: Launch a grappling hook and pull yourself to the target location. For 3 sec after using it you can recast it, pulling yourself to an enemy and rooting them for 1 sec. Does not break stealth.

Name: Kick
Description: A quick kick that interrupts spellcasting and prevents any spell in that school from being cast for 4 sec.     This ability shares a cooldown with other interrupts.

Name: Killing Spree
Description: Step through the shadows from enemy to enemy within 10 yards, attacking an enemy for 130% weapon damage (195% with Daggers) every 0.5 sec with both weapons until 5 assaults are made.  Can hit the same target multiple times.  Cannot hit invisible or stealthed targets.

Name: Recuperate
Description: Finishing move that consumes combo points on your target to restore 3% of your maximum health every 3 sec. Lasts longer per combo point:    1 point : 3 seconds    2 points: 6 seconds    3 points: 9 seconds    4 points: 12 seconds    5 points: 15 seconds

Name: Riposte
Description: A strike that becomes active after parrying an opponent's attack.  This attack deals 150% weapon damage and slows their melee attack speed by 20% for 30 sec. Awards 1 combo point. Does not stack with other similar effects.

Name: Roll the Bones
Description: Roll the dice of fate, providing a random lesser or great combat enhancement for 10 sec. Only one enhancement can be active at the same time.    This ability is usable while shapeshifted.

Name: Shiv
Description: Performs an instant off-hand weapon attack that automatically applies the poison from your off-hand weapon to the target.  Slower weapons require more Energy. Shiv can not critically strike. Awards 1 combo point.

Name: Shuriken Toss
Description: A ranged attack that deals 30 to 29 Physical damage to an enemy target. Awards 1 combo point.

Name: Sinister Strike
Description: An instant strike that causes 3 damage in addition to 100% of your normal weapon damage (85% if a Two-Handed weapon is equipped). Awards 1 combo point.

Name: Sprint
Description: Increases your movement speed by 50% for 15 sec.  Does not break stealth.

Name: Accuracy
Description: Increases your chance to hit with all spells and attacks by 5%.

Name: Aggression
Description: Increases the critical strike chance of your Sinister Strike, Shuriken Toss, Deadly Throw and Eviscerate by 15%.     Increases the duration of effects gained from Roll the Bones by 15 sec.    Capstone Bonus: Your finishing moves reduces the cooldown of Roll the Bones by 2 sec per combo point used.

Name: Blade Twisting
Description: Increases the damage dealt by Sinister Strike, Backstab and Shiv by 10%, and your Shiv and Grappling Hook Follow-Up has a 100% chance to Daze the target for 4 sec.

Name: Close Quarters Combat
Description: Increases your chance to get a critical strike with Daggers and Fist Weapons by 10%.

Name: Combat Potency
Description: Gives your successful off-hand melee attacks a 100% chance to generate 5 Energy.

Name: Deflection
Description: Increases your Parry chance by 3%.     Increases the damage of your Ghostly Strike and Riposte by 15%.    You have a 100% chance to reduce the cooldown of your Ghostly Strike ability by 3 seconds after using Riposte.    Does not stack with other Deflection talents.

Name: Dual Wield Specialization
Description: Increases your critical strike chance by 5%.    Increases the damage done by your off-hand weapon by 33%.  Does not stack with Dual Wield Mastery

Name: Endurance
Description: Increases your total Stamina by 4%.    Reduces the cooldown of your Evasion and Sprint by 60 sec.

Name: Hack and Slash
Description: Gives you a 6% chance to get an extra attack with both weapons dealing 100% weapon damage after hitting your target with your One-Handed Sword or One-handed Axe.

Name: Improved Gouge
Description: Increases the effect duration of your Gouge ability by 1.5 sec.

Name: Improved Kick
Description: Gives your Kick ability a 100% chance to silence the target for 2 sec.  Your successful interrupts with Kick grant you 40 energy.

Name: Improved Sinister Strike
Description: Reduces the Energy cost of your Sinister Strike ability by 5.

Name: Improved Slice and Dice
Description: Increases the duration of your Slice and Dice ability by 50% and increases the attack speed it grants by 6%.

Name: Improved Sprint
Description: Gives a 100% chance to remove all Movement Impairing effects when you activate your Sprint ability.

Name: Mace Specialization
Description: Increases your melee attack speed by 10% and armor penetration by 15% while a mace is equipped.

Name: Nerves of Steel
Description: Reduces damage taken while affected by Stun and Fear effects by 20%.

Name: Prey on the Weak
Description: Melee attacks against the target that has less health than you (as a percentage of total health) increase your critical strike damage bonus by 20%.

Name: Quick Reflexes
Description: Increases your haste by 9% and your Dodge chance by 6%.  Capstone Bonus: All threat generated is reduced by 30%. This capstone effect does not stack with similar capstone effects.

Name: Savage Combat
Description: Increases your total attack power by 4%.    All Physical damage on enemies you have poisoned is increased by 4%.   Does not stack with other similar effects.

Name: Surprise Attacks
Description: Your Rogue finishing moves can no longer be dodged.    Increases damage dealt by your Sinister Strike, Shuriken Toss, Backstab, Ambush, Shiv, Hemorrhage and Gouge abilities by 10%.

Name: Throwing Specialization
Description: Reduces the energy cost of Shuriken Toss by 10.     Increases the range of Shuriken Toss, Throw and Deadly Throw by 6 yards.     Your Deadly Throw has a 100% chance to interrupt the target for 3 sec.

Name: Unfair Advantage
Description: Whenever you dodge or parry an attack you gain an Unfair Advantage, striking back for 100% of your main hand weapon's damage.      This cannot occur more than once per 1 seconds.

Name: Vitality
Description: Increases your Energy regeneration rate by 40%.

Name: Weapon Expertise
Description: Increases your Expertise by 10.

Name: Blind
Description: Blinds the target, causing it to wander disoriented for up to 10 sec.  Any damage caused will remove the effect.

Name: Cloak of Shadows
Description: Instantly removes all existing harmful spell effects, Increases your chance to resist all spells by 90% for 5 sec.     Does not remove effects that prevent you from using Cloak of Shadows.

Name: Detect Traps
Description: Greatly increased chance to detect traps.

Name: Disarm Trap
Description: Disarm a hostile trap.

Name: Distract
Description: Throws a distraction, attracting the attention of all nearby monsters for 10 seconds.  Does not break stealth.

Name: Ghostly Strike
Description: A strike that deals 125% weapon damage (180% if a dagger is equipped, 100% if a Two-Handed weapon is equipped).     Increases your chance to dodge (or parry if a single Two-Handed weapon is equipped) by 10% for 8 sec. Awards 1 combo point.

Name: Gloomblade
Description: Punctures the target with your shadow-infused blade, causing 90% weapon damage as Shadow and inflicting Gloomblade for 6 sec, causing your melee abilities on the target to trigger additional 17 Shadow damage. Awards 1 combo point.

Name: Hemorrhage
Description: An instant strike that deals 100% weapon damage and applies Hemorrhage, increasing Physical damage taken by up to 9. Lasts 10 charges or 15 sec. Awards 1 combo point.    Deals 175% weapon damage if a dagger is equipped and 85% if a two-hander is equipped.

Name: Pick Lock
Description: Allows opening of locked chests and doors.

Name: Pick Pocket
Description: Pick the target's pocket, taking loot from them!

Name: Premeditation
Description: When used, adds 2 combo points to your target. Must be stealthed. You must add to or use those combo points within 20 sec or the combo points are lost.  This ability is usable while shapeshifted.

Name: Preparation
Description: When activated, this ability immediately resets the cooldown on your Evasion, Sprint, Vanish, Cold Blood and Shadowstep abilities.  This ability is usable while shapeshifted.

Name: Safe Fall
Description: Reduces damage from falling.

Name: Sap
Description: Incapacitates the target for up to 25 sec (10 seconds on players).  Must be stealthed. Only works on Humanoids that are not in combat.  Any damage caused will revive the target. Only 1 target may be sapped at a time.

Name: Shadow Dance
Description: Enter the Shadow Dance for 8 sec, allowing the use of Sap, Garrote, Ambush, Cheap Shot, Premeditation, Pickpocket, Disarm Trap, Ravage and Pounce regardless of being stealthed or prowled.

Name: Shadowstep
Description: Attempts to step through the shadows and reappear behind your enemy and increases movement speed by 70% for 3 sec.   This ability is usable while shapeshifted.

Name: Stealth
Description: Allows you to sneak around, but reduces your speed by 30%. Removes invulnerabilities when used. Lasts until cancelled.

Name: Trickery Mastery
Description: You gain Trickery Mastery when learning any Trickery Spell.     This Mastery automatically unlocks additional Trickery Spells when you reach their Class Point requirements at no additional ability essence cost.    Pick Lock Allows opening of locked chests and doors.   Detect Traps Greatly increased chance to detect traps.    Disarm Trap Disarm a hostile trap.

Name: Tricks of the Trade
Description: The party or raid member you have targeted receives the threat caused by your next damaging attack and all threat you cause for 6 sec. Their damage is increased by 15%.

Name: Vanish
Description: Allows you to vanish from sight, entering an improved stealth mode for 10 sec.  Also breaks movement impairing effects.

Name: Camouflage
Description: Increases your speed while in Stealth or Prowl by 15%.    Reduces the cooldown of your Stealth and Prowl ability by 6 sec.

Name: Cheat Death
Description: You have a 100% chance to fully absorb an attack which would otherwise kill you, up to a maximum of 15% of your total health. In addition, all damage taken will be reduced by 50% for 3 sec.     This effect shares a 2 minute cooldown with Ardent Defender and Spirit of Redemption.  Capstone Bonus: With the final rank of this talent, cheating death also resets your Vanish.

Name: Deadliness
Description: Increases your attack power by 10%.

Name: Dirty Deeds
Description: Reduces the Energy cost of your Cheap Shot and Garrote abilities by 20.     Your Rogue abilities cause 20% more damage against targets below 35% health.

Name: Dirty Tricks
Description: Increases the range of your Blind and Sap abilities by 5 yards.    Reduces the energy cost of your Blind and Sap abilities by 50%.

Name: Elusiveness
Description: Reduces the cooldown of Vanish and Smoke Bomb by 60 sec.     Reduces the cooldown of Cloak of Shadows by 30 sec.

Name: Enveloping Shadows
Description: Reduces the damage taken from area of effect attacks by 30%.    This does not stack with other similar effects.

Name: Filthy Tricks
Description: Reduces the cooldown by 10 sec and energy cost by 10 of your Tricks of the Trade, Distract and Shadowstep.    Reduces the cooldown of Preparation by 3 min.    Increases the damage of Gloomblade by 20%.

Name: Heightened Senses
Description: Increases your Stealth detection and reduces all damage you take by 4%. More effective than Heightened Senses (Rank 1).

Name: Honor Among Thieves
Description: When anyone in your group critically hits with a damage or healing spell or ability, you have a 100% chance to gain a combo point.    This effect cannot occur more than once every 2 sec.

Name: Initiative
Description: Gives you a 100% chance to add an additional combo point to your target when using your Ambush, Garrote, or Cheap Shot ability.

Name: Master of Deception
Description: Greatly reduces the chance enemies have to detect you while using Stealth or Prowl.  More effective than Master of Deception (Rank 2).

Name: Master of Subtlety
Description: Physical attacks made while stealthed and for 6 seconds after breaking stealth cause an additional 12% damage.    Master of Subtlety doesn't stack with other similar effects.

Name: Opportunity
Description: Increases the damage dealt with your Backstab, Mutilate, Garrote, Ambush and Gloomblade abilities by 20%.

Name: Out of Nowhere
Description: Increases the critical strike chance of your Ambush ability by 50%.

Name: Relentless Strikes
Description: Your finishing moves have a 20% chance per combo point to restore 25 energy.

Name: Serrated Blades
Description: Your attacks to ignore up to 18% of your target's Armor.    Increases the damage dealt by your Rupture ability by 30%.

Name: Setup
Description: Gives you a 100% chance to add a combo point to your target after dodging or parrying their attack.  This cannot happen more than once per second.   Increases the duration of your Ghostly Strike effect by 6 seconds.

Name: Sinister Calling
Description: Increases your total Agility by 6%.    Increases the damage done by Hemorrhage by an additional 9%.    Increases the duration of Gloomblade by 3 seconds.  Capstone Bonus: Hemorrhage applies an additional combo point if the target has a bleed effect active.

Name: Slaughter from the Shadows
Description: Reduces the energy cost of your Backstab and Ambush abilities by 10 and the energy cost of your Hemorrhage by 6.    Damaging spells and abilities have a 100% chance to reduce the cooldown of your Shadow Dance by 1 seconds.

Name: Sleight of Hand
Description: Reduces the chance you are critically hit by melee and ranged attacks by 2%.    Increases the threat reduction of your Feint ability by 20%.

Name: Waylay
Description: Your Ambush and Backstab hits have a 100% chance to unbalance a target, increasing the time between their melee and ranged attacks by 20%, and reducing movement speed by 50% for 8 sec.

Name: Air Elemental Totem
Description: Summons an elemental totem that calls forth a greater air elemental to rain destruction on the caster's enemies. Lasts 2 min.    This ability is usable while shapeshifted.  This uses Fire Elemental Totem modifiers.

Name: Air Totem Mastery
Description: You gain Air Totem Mastery when learning any Air Totem.     This Mastery automatically unlocks additional Air Totems when you reach their Class Point requirements at no additional ability essence cost.    Windwalk Totem Places a Totem that provides movement speed to allies around it.    Nature Resistance Totem Places a Totem that provides Nature Resistance to allies around it.    Grounding Totem Places a Totem that redirects one harmful effect from you to the totem and then destroys itself.    Windfury Totem Places a Totem that provides melee haste to allies around it.    Capacitor Totem Places a Totem that after 2 seconds deals Nature damage and stuns enemies around it.    Wrath of Air Totem Places a Totem that provides Spell haste to allies around it.    Air Elemental Totem Summons an air elemental that rains destruction on your enemies.

Name: Call of the Ancestors
Description: Simultaneously places up to 4 totems specified in the Totem Bar. Can call different totems than Call of the Elements.

Name: Call of the Elements
Description: Simultaneously places up to 4 totems specified in the Totem Bar.

Name: Call of the Spirits
Description: Simultaneously places up to 4 totems specified in the Totem Bar. Can call different totems than Call of the Elements or Call of the Ancestors.

Name: Capacitor Totem
Description: Summons an Air totem with 5 health within 20 yards that gathers electrical energy from the surrounding air and then explodes after 2 sec to deal Nature damage and stun all enemies within 8 yards for 4 sec.  Deals 300% increased damage versus targets permanently immune to stuns.  This ability is usable while shapeshifted.

Name: Chain Lightning
Description: Hurls a lightning bolt at the enemy, dealing 85 to 96 Nature damage and then jumping to additional nearby enemies.  Each jump reduces the damage by 30%. Affects 3 total targets.

Name: Earth Shock
Description: Instantly shocks the target with concussive force, causing 13 to 15 Nature damage and reducing melee attack speed by 10% for 8 sec.   Does not stack with other similar effects.  This ability shares a cooldown with Shaman Shock spells.

Name: Earth Totem Mastery
Description: You gain Earth Totem Mastery when learning any Earth Totem.     This Mastery automatically unlocks additional Earth Totems when you reach their Class Point requirements at no additional ability essence cost.   Stoneskin Totem Places a Totem that provies armor to allies around it.    Stoneclaw Totem Places a Totem that taunts enemies around it, forcing them to attack it.    Earthbind Totem Places a Totem that slows enemies around it.   Strength of Earth Totem Places a Totem that provides Strength and Agility to allies around it.    Tremor Totem Places a Totem that removes fears, charms and sleep effect from your allies.    Petrification Totem Places a Totem that slows enemies around it and after 3 seconds causes them to fall asleep.    Earth Elemental Totem Summons an earth elemental that protects the caster and their allies.

Name: Earthbind Totem
Description: Summons an Earthbind Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster for 45 sec that slows the movement speed of enemies within 10 yards.  This ability is usable while shapeshifted.

Name: Earthquake
Description: You cause the earth to tremble at your target location, dealing Nature damage every 1 sec to enemies within an 8 yard radius and reducing their movement speed by 25%. Lasts 8 sec.  Enemies damaged by Earthquake are afflicted with Trembling. At 3 stacks, Trembling stuns the target for 3 sec. This effect can only occur once every 10 sec from any Earthquake effect.

Name: Elemental Blast
Description: Harness and direct the raw power of the elements towards an enemy target, dealing Elemental damage and increasing the caster's critical strike chance or spell casting speed for 8 seconds.

Name: Elemental Mastery
Description: When activated, your next Lightning Bolt, Chain Lightning or Lava Burst becomes instant and costs no mana. In addition, you gain 10% spell haste for 15 sec.   Does not stack with other similar cast speed increasing effects.

Name: Fire Elemental Totem
Description: Summons an elemental totem that calls forth a greater fire elemental to rain destruction on the caster's enemies.  Lasts 2 min.  This ability is usable while shapeshifted.

Name: Fire Nova
Description: Causes your active Fire Totem to emit a wave of flames, inflicting 48 to 56 Fire damage to enemies within 10 yards of the totem.    This ability is usable while shapeshifted.

Name: Fire Totem Mastery
Description: You gain Fire Totem Mastery when learning any Fire Totem.     This Mastery automatically unlocks additional Fire Totems when you reach their Class Point requirements at no additional ability essence cost.   Searing Totem Places a Totem that shoots bolts of fire an enemy around it.   Flametongue Totem Places a Totem that provides Intellect and spell power to allies around it.   Magma Totem Places a Totem that deals Fire damage to enemies around it.    Frost Resistance Totem Places a Totem that provides Frost Resistance to allies around it.    Totem of Wrath Places a Totem that provides Intellect and spell power to nearby allies, additionally allies have increased critical strike chance against nearby enemies.    Fire Elemental Totem Summons a fire elemental that rains destruction on your enemies.

Name: Flame Ascendance
Description: Transform into a being of raw elemental energy for 15 sec, casting Flame Shock on up to 10 nearby enemies within 10 yards if known. Chain Lightning becomes Lava Beam. Lava Burst's cooldown is reduced by 50%.      Lava Beam Unleash a blast of superheated flame at the enemy, dealing 186 Firestorm damage and then jumping to additional nearby enemies. Affects 3 total targets.    Lava Beam cannot be cast unless you're affected by Flame Ascendance.

Name: Flame Shock
Description: Instantly sears the target with fire, causing 21 Fire damage immediately and 42 Fire damage over 18 sec. This periodic damage may critically strike and will occur more rapidly based on the caster's spell haste.   This ability shares a cooldown with Shaman Shock spells.

Name: Frost Shock
Description: Instantly shocks the target with frost, causing 89 to 95 Frost damage and slowing movement speed by 50%. Lasts 8 sec. Causes a high amount of threat.  This ability shares a cooldown with other Shaman Shock spells.

Name: Hex
Description: Transforms the enemy into a frog. While hexed, the target cannot attack or cast spells. Damage caused may interrupt the effect. Lasts 30 sec. Only one target can be hexed at a time. Only works on Humanoids and Beasts.

Name: Lava Burst
Description: You hurl molten lava at the target, dealing 174 to 221 Fire damage. If your Flame Shock is on the target, Lava Burst will deal a critical strike.

Name: Lightning Bolt
Description: Casts a bolt of lightning at the target for 13 to 15 Nature damage.

Name: Magma Totem
Description: Summons a Magma Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster for 20 sec that causes 38 Fire damage to creatures within 8 yards every 2 seconds.  This ability is usable while shapeshifted.

Name: Petrification Totem
Description: Summons a Petrification Totem with 5 health at your feet for 5 sec, slowing enemies within 8 yards. After 3 seconds, it Petrifies enemies for 5 seconds.    Petrified Asleep. Damage taken reduced by 50%. Effect breaks on any damage taken. This ability is usable while shapeshifted.

Name: Purge
Description: Purges the enemy target, removing 1 beneficial magic effect.

Name: Searing Totem
Description: Summons a Searing Totem with 5 health at your feet for 45 sec that repeatedly attacks an enemy within 20 yards for 11 to 14 Fire damage.  This ability is usable while shapeshifted.

Name: Shock Mastery
Description: You gain Shock Mastery when learning any Shaman Shock.     This Mastery automatically unlocks additional Shaman Shocks when you reach their Class Point requirements at no additional ability essence cost.   Earth Shock Shocks the target, dealing nature damage and reducing their melee attack speed.   Flame Shock Sear the target with fire causing instant Fire damage and additional Fire damage over time.   Frost Shock Shock the target with frost, causing Frost damage and slowing the target's movement speed.

Name: Stoneclaw Totem
Description: Summons a Stoneclaw Totem with 50 health at the feet of the caster for 15 sec that taunts creatures within 8 yards to attack it.  Enemies attacking the Stoneclaw Totem have a 50% chance to be stunned for 3 sec. Stoneclaw totem also protects all your totems, causing them to absorb 21 damage.  This ability is usable while shapeshifted.

Name: Tether Elemental
Description: Teaches you the necessary abilities to tether an Elemental companion.    Teaches you Tether Elemental, Raise Elemental, Dismiss Elemental, Revive Elemental and Elemental Lore.      Tether Elemental Begins tethering an elemental to be your companion.     Your armor is reduced by 100% while you focus on dominating the elemental for 20 sec.     If you lose the elemental's attention for any reason, the domination process will fail.     Each type of elemental has unique abilities that you will be able to make use of.

Name: Thunderstorm
Description: You call down a bolt of lightning, energizing you and damaging nearby enemies within 10 yards. Restores 8% mana to you and deals 292 to 333 Nature damage to all nearby enemies, knocking them back 20 yards.    Usable while stunned.

Name: Totem of Wrath
Description: Summons a Totem of Wrath with 5 health at the feet of the caster.     The totem increases Intellect by 22 and spell power by 23 for all party and raid members, and increases critical strike chance against all nearby targets by 3%. Lasts 5 min.   Does not stack with other similar effects.  This ability is usable while shapeshifted.

Name: Totemic Call Mastery
Description: You gain Totemic Call Mastery when learning any Totemic Call Spell.     This Mastery automatically unlocks additional Totemic Call Spells when you reach their Class Point requirements at no additional ability essence cost.   Call of the Elements Simultaneously places up to 4 totems specified in the Totem Bar.   Call of the Ancestors Simultaneously places up to 4 totems specified in the Totem Bar. Can call different totems than Call of the Elements.   Call of the Spirits Simultaneously places up to 4 totems specified in the Totem Bar. Can call different totems than Call of the Elements or Call of the Ancestors.

Name: Wind Shear
Description: Instantly blasts the target with a gust of wind, causing no damage but interrupting spellcasting and preventing spells of that school of magic from being cast for 2 sec.   This ability shares a cooldown with other interrupts.

Name: Astral Shift
Description: When stunned, feared or silenced you shift into the Astral Plane reducing all damage taken by 30% for the duration of the stun, fear or silence effect.

Name: Booming Echoes
Description: Increases the damage done by your Earth Shock, Flame Shock, Frost Shock and Elemental Blast spells by 15%.  Capstone Bonus: Dealing damage with a Shaman Shock spell increases your damage with that magic school by 5% for 12 seconds.

Name: Call of Flame
Description: Increases the damage done by your Fire Totems and Fire Nova by 15%.    Increases the damage done by your Lava Burst spell by 6%.

Name: Call of Thunder
Description: Increases the critical strike chance of your Lightning Bolt, Chain Lightning and Thunderstorm spells by an additional 5%.

Name: Concussion
Description: Increases your Frost, Fire, and Nature damage done by 5%.

Name: Convection
Description: Reduces the mana cost of your Shock, Lightning Bolt, Chain Lightning, Lava Burst, Earthquake and Wind Shear spells by 15%.

Name: Elemental Devastation
Description: Your direct offensive spell critical hits increase your critical strike chance with melee and ranged attacks by 9% for 10 sec.

Name: Elemental Focus
Description: After landing a critical strike with a Fire, Frost, or Nature damaging spell or ability you have a 100% chance to enter a Clearcasting state.     The Clearcasting state reduces the resource cost of your next 2 Magic spells by 40%.

Name: Elemental Fury
Description: Your spell critical strikes now deal 200% damage.     This does not stack with other similar effects.  Capstone Bonus: Your Nature damage is increased by 6% and other magic damage increased by 3% while Clearcasting from Elemental Focus is active.

Name: Elemental Oath
Description: While Clearcasting from Elemental Focus is active, you deal 10% more spell damage. In addition, party and raid members within 100 yards receive a 5% bonus to their spell critical strike chance.   Does not stack with other similar effects.

Name: Elemental Precision
Description: Increases your hit chance by 3%.  Capstone Bonus: All threat generated is reduced by 30%. This capstone effect does not stack with similar capstone effects.

Name: Elemental Reach
Description: Increases the range of your damaging spells by 6 yards.   This does not stack with other similar effects.  Capstone Bonus: Your direct damage Fire, Nature and Frost spells on targets further than 20 yards away from you have a 33% chance to increase your magic damage by 6% for 10 sec. This effect can only occur once every 15 sec.

Name: Elemental Warding
Description: Reduces all Fire, Frost and Nature damage taken by 6%.    Reduces all damage that your Tethered Elemental suffers by 15% and increases their threat by 150%.

Name: Eye of the Storm
Description: Increases your haste by 2%.     Reduces spell pushback suffered from damaging attacks by 70%.

Name: Improved Lightning Bolt
Description: Reduces the cast time of your Lightning Bolt by 0.3 sec and increases its damage by 6%.

Name: Lava Flows
Description: Increases the critical strike damage bonus of your Lava Burst, Flame Shock, Sundering and Lava Lash by an additional 25%.    Casting Flame Shock or Lava Burst your spell and melee haste is increased by 6% for 12 sec.    If your Flame Shock is dispelled your haste is increased by 30% for 8 sec.

Name: Lightning Mastery
Description: Your Lightning Bolt, Chain Lightning and Thunderstorm criticals have a 15% chance to increase your spell critical strike damage bonus by 50% for 6 seconds.

Name: Lightning Overload
Description: Gives your Lightning Bolt and Chain Lightning spells a 20% chance to cast a second, similar spell on the same target at no additional cost that causes half damage. This chance is tripled for critical strikes.

Name: Power of the Elements
Description: Grants you and your tethered elemental an effect based on its active element.  Fire: Increases critical strike chance and hit chance for you and your elemental by 5%.  Water: Increases healing done for you and your elemental and reduces the mana cost of all spells by 5%.  Air: Increases haste for you and your elemental and reduces magical damage taken by 5%.  Earth: Reduces damage taken by you and your elemental by 5% and increases stamina by 5%.  Other Elementals: Increases all damage done by 5% and decreases all damage taken by 5%.

Name: Raze
Description: Increases your spell critical strike chance by 3%.

Name: Reverberation
Description: Reduces the cooldown of your Shaman Shocks by 1.5 sec.     When you deal damage with a Shaman Shock spell you have a 100% to increase the direct damage of your next different Shaman Shock or Elemental Blast spell within 8 sec by 20%.

Name: Rising Flames
Description: Increases the cast speed of your Searing Totem by 30% and the critical strike damage bonus of your Searing and Magma totems by 100%.     Reduces the cooldown of Fire Nova by 4 sec. and increases its damage by 20%.

Name: Shamanism
Description: Increases the spell damage scaling of your Lightning Bolt and Chain Lightning by 20%.    You have a 100% chance when dealing Nature damage to reduce the cooldown of Elemental Mastery and Thunderstorm by 1 second.  Capstone Bonus: Increases the amount of haste granted by your Elemental Mastery by an additional 5%.

Name: Storm, Earth and Fire
Description: Reduces the cooldown of your Chain Lightning spell by 2.5 sec.    Earthbind Totem has a 100% chance to root targets for 5 sec when cast.    The periodic damage done by your Flame Shock is increased by 60%.

Name: Unrelenting Storm
Description: Your direct damaging Nature spells and abilities increase your haste by 3% for 8 sec. This effect stacks up to 3 times.  Capstone Bonus: At three stacks of  Unrelenting Storm, your Chain Lightning now causes the target to take 13% increased spell damage for 12 seconds. This does not stack with similar effects.

Name: Air Ascendance
Description: You surrender your physical form to the power of the elements, transforming into a being of raw elemental energy for 15 sec.     Your Stormstrike has a 30 yard range and deals extra Elemental damage.    The cooldown of Stormstrike is reset when using any Shaman Shock, Lightning Bolt or Chain Lightning.

Name: Astral Recall
Description: Yanks the caster through the twisting nether back to Teldrassil.  Speak to an Innkeeper in a different place to change your home location.

Name: Bloodlust
Description: Increases melee and ranged attack speed by 30% and casting speed by 20% for all party and raid members.  Lasts 40 sec.  After the completion of this effect, those affected will become Sated and unable to benefit from Bloodlust again for 10 min.  This ability is usable while shapeshifted.

Name: Earth Elemental Totem
Description: Summon an elemental totem that calls forth a greater earth elemental to protect the caster and her allies.  Lasts 2 min.  This ability is usable while shapeshifted.

Name: Elemental Shield Mastery
Description: You gain Elemental Shield Mastery when learning any Elemental Shield Spell.     This Mastery automatically unlocks additional Elemental Shield Spells when you reach their Class Point requirements at no additional ability essence cost.    Lightning Shield Surround the caster with balls of lightning, causing enemies who attack you to take nature damage.   Water Shield Surround yourself with globes of water, providing mana regen. When an enemy damages you, you gain additional mana.    Earth Shield Protects a targeted ally with earth. When enemies attack the targeted ally, the ally receives healing. Also reduces pushback while active.

Name: Feral Spirit
Description: Summons two Spirit Wolves under the command of the Shaman, lasting 45 sec.  This ability is usable while shapeshifted.

Name: Fire Resistance Totem
Description: Summons a Fire Resistance Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster for 5 min that increases the fire resistance of party and raid members within 50 yards by 30.  This ability is usable while shapeshifted.

Name: Flametongue Totem
Description: Summons a Flametongue Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster.  Party and raid members within 50 yards of the totem have their Intellect increased by 2 and spell power increased by 2.  Lasts 5 min.   Does not stack with other similar effects.  This ability is usable while shapeshifted.

Name: Flametongue Weapon
Description: Imbue your weapon with fire, increasing total Spell power by 7. Each auto attack and melee ability causes 4.2 to 13.0 additional fire damage, based on the speed of the weapon. Slower weapons cause more fire damage per swing. This effect lasts for 2 hours.

Name: Frost Resistance Totem
Description: Summons a Frost Resistance Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster for 5 min. The totem increases party and raid members' frost resistance by 30, if within 50 yards.  This ability is usable while shapeshifted.

Name: Frostbrand Weapon
Description: Imbue your weapon with frost increasing your Frost spell power by 16. Each hit has a chance of causing 31 additional Frost damage and slowing the target's movement speed by 50% for 8 sec. This effect lasts for 2 hours.

Name: Ghost Wolf
Description: Turns the caster into a Ghost Wolf, increasing speed by 30%. As a Ghost Wolf, effects that reduce movement speed may not bring you below your normal movement speed. Only usable outdoors.

Name: Grounding Totem
Description: Summons a Grounding Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster that will redirect one harmful spell from the caster to itself, destroying the totem. Will not redirect area of effect spells. Lasts 45 sec.  This ability is usable while shapeshifted.

Name: Lava Lash
Description: You charge your off-hand weapon with lava, instantly dealing 100% off-hand Weapon damage as Firestrike damage.     The damage increased by 25% if your off-hand weapon is enchanted with Flametongue.

Name: Lightning Shield
Description: The caster is surrounded by 3 balls of lightning.  When a spell, melee or ranged attack hits the caster, the attacker will be struck for 13 Nature damage. This expends one lightning ball. Only one ball will fire every 3 seconds. Lasts 10 min.     Only one Elemental Shield can be active on the Hero at any one time.

Name: Nature Resistance Totem
Description: Summons a Nature Resistance Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster for 5 min that increases the nature resistance of party and raid members within 50 yards by 30.  This ability is usable while shapeshifted.

Name: Rockbiter Weapon
Description: Imbue your weapon, increasing attack power by 20. The attack power granted is doubled for two-handed weapons. You only gain 33% of the attack power while your Primary Stat is Intellect or Spirit. This effect lasts for 2 hours.

Name: Shamanistic Rage
Description: Reduces all damage taken by 30% and gives your successful melee and ranged attacks a chance to regenerate mana equal to 15% of your attack power. This spell is usable while stunned. Lasts 15 sec.    This ability is usable while Shapeshifted.

Name: Stoneskin Totem
Description: Summons a Stoneskin Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster. The totem protects party and raid members within 50 yards, increasing armor by 95. Lasts 5 min.   This ability is usable while shapeshifted.

Name: Stormstrike
Description: Instantly attack with both weapons for 100% weapon damage.  In addition, the next 4 sources of Nature damage dealt to the target from the Shaman are increased by 20%. Lasts 12 sec.

Name: Strength of Earth Totem
Description: Summons a Strength of Earth Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster. The totem increases the Strength and Agility of all party and raid members within 50 yards by 8. Lasts 5 min.   Does not stack with other similar effects.  This ability is usable while shapeshifted.

Name: Sundering
Description: Shatters a line of earth in front of you, causing 111 Firestrike damage and Incapacitating any enemy hit for 3 sec. This effect does not break from periodic Fire damage. Also, resets the cooldown of Lava Burst.

Name: Water Breathing
Description: Allows the target to breathe underwater for 30 min and increases swim speed by 20%.  This ability is usable while shapeshifted.

Name: Water Walking
Description: Allows the friendly target to walk across water for 10 min. Any damage will cancel the effect.  This ability is usable while shapeshifted.

Name: Weapon Enhancement Mastery
Description: You gain Weapon Enhancement Mastery when learning any Weapon Enhancement Spell.     This Mastery automatically unlocks Weapon Enhancement Spells when you reach their Class Point requirements at no additional ability essence cost.    Rockbiter Weapon Imbue your weapon with earthen might, increasing attack power.    Flametongue Weapon Imbue your weapon with fire, increasing spell power and spell crit chance. Additionally your auto attacks apply Fire damage.    Frostbrand Weapon Imbue your weapon with frost, causing your attacks to deal Frost damage and slow the target.    Windfury Weapon Imbue your weapon with wind. Your attacks have a chance to cause another swing that deals more damage.    Earthliving Weapon Imbue your weapon with earthen life. Increasing healing done and each direct heal has a chance apply a healing over time effect.

Name: Windfury Totem
Description: Summons a Windfury Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster. The totem provides 16% melee haste to all party and raid members within 50 yards.  Lasts 5 min.  This ability is usable while shapeshifted.

Name: Windfury Weapon
Description: Imbue your weapon with wind.  Each hit has a 20% chance of dealing additional damage equal to two extra attacks with 46 extra attack power.    This effect lasts for 2 hours.

Name: Wrath of Air Totem
Description: Summons a Wrath of Air Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster. The totem provides 5% spell haste to all party and raid members within 50 yards. Lasts 5 min.   Does not stack with other similar effects.  This ability is usable while shapeshifted.

Name: Ancestral Knowledge
Description: Increases your Intellect by 6%.    Reduces the mana cost of your Shaman spells by 10%.

Name: Anticipation
Description: Increases your dodge chance by 3%.     Reduces the duration of all Disarm effects used against you by 50%. This does not stack with other Disarm duration reducing effects.

Name: Dual Wield Specialization
Description: Increases your hit chance while dual wielding by 3%.     Your off-hand auto attacks have a chance to increase your Fire, Frost, and Nature damage dealt by 6% for 8 sec.

Name: Earth's Grasp
Description: Increases the health of your Stoneclaw Totem by 50% and the radius of your Earthbind Totem by 20%, and reduces the cooldown of both totems by 30%.

Name: Earthen Power
Description: Using Earthbind Totem has a 100% chance to remove all slow effects from you and nearby friendly targets.    Your Earth Shock reduces enemy attack speed by an additional 10%.

Name: Elemental Weapons
Description: Increases the damage caused by your Windfury Weapon effect by 30%.    Increases the spell damage on your Flametongue Weapon by 60%.    Increases the Frost spell damage granted on your Frostbrand Weapon by 100%.    Increases the bonus healing on your Earthliving Weapon by 100%.

Name: Empowered Stormstrike
Description: Your Stormstrike will deal an additional 25% weapon damage as Fire when you have a weapon imbued with Flametongue and an additional 25% weapon damage as Frost when you have a weapon imbued with Frostbrand.     After casting Stormstrike your auto-attacks will deal an additional 0 Nature damage for 8 sec.

Name: Enhanced Weapon Mastery
Description: Increases all damage done by 10%.

Name: Enhancing Totems
Description: Placing a totem increases your attack power by 1 and spell power by 0 for 5 minutes. This effect scales with your level.

Name: Flurry
Description: Increases your melee attack speed by 30% for your next 3 swings after dealing a melee critical strike.

Name: Frozen Power
Description: Increase your Frost, Fire and Nature damage done by 4% on targets affected by your Frostbrand.    Your Frost damage has a 20% chance to freeze the target for 5 sec when used on targets at or further than 15 yards from you. This effect can only occur once every 10 sec.

Name: Guardian Totems
Description: Increases the amount of armor increased by your Stoneskin Totem by 20%.    Reduces the cooldown of your Grounding Totem by 4 sec.

Name: Improved Ghost Wolf
