Description: Increases movement speed and reduces damage taken in Ghost Wolf by 10%.   Capstone Bonus: Using Ghost Wolf removes all movement impairing effects and increases your speed by 60% for 2 sec. This can only occur once every 20 seconds.

Name: Improved Shields
Description: Increases the damage done by your Lightning Shield orbs by 15%.    Increases the amount of mana gained from your Water Shield orbs by 15%.    Increases the amount of healing done by your Earth Shield orbs by 15%.

Name: Improved Stormstrike
Description: When you Stormstrike, you have a 100% chance to immediately grant you 20% of your base mana.

Name: Improved Windfury Totems
Description: Increases the melee haste granted by your Windfury totem by 4%.

Name: Maelstrom Weapon
Description: When you deal damage with a melee weapon, you have a chance (greater than previous rank) to reduce the cast time of your next damaging or healing Fire, Frost or Nature spell by 20%. Stacks up to 5.    Reduces the cast time of Pyroblast by 0.5 sec per stack.

Name: Mental Dexterity
Description: Requires  Primary Stat: Agility or Duality Increases your hit rating by 15% of your Intellect.  Capstone Bonus: You gain an additional 10% of your Intellect as melee critical strike rating and 10% of your Agility as spell critical strike rating.

Name: Mental Quickness
Description: Dealing direct physical damage increases your magic damage done by 10% for 6 sec.  Dealing direct magic damage increases your physical damage done by 10% for 6 sec.  Only one damage bonus can be active at a time.

Name: Shamanistic Focus
Description: Reduces the mana cost of your Shaman Shock spells by 45%.

Name: Spirit Weapons
Description: Reduces all threat generated by 30%.    Increases damage done by your Windfury and Flametongue Weapon Enhancements by 5%.

Name: Static Shock
Description: Your Lightning Shield gains 6 additional charges and you have a 15% chance to hit your target with a Lightning Shield orb charge when you deal damage with melee attacks and abilities.

Name: Thundering Strikes
Description: Increases your chance to get a critical strike with all spells and attacks by 5%.  Capstone Bonus: Dealing damage with spell have a chance to increases your Agility by 1 (based on your level) for 12 seconds. This effect can only trigger once every 6 seconds.

Name: Toughness
Description: Increases your Stamina by 10%, and reduces the duration of movement slowing effects on you by 30%.

Name: Unleashed Rage
Description: Increases your Expertise by 9.    Fire, Frost and Nature damage done increased by 9% while under the effects of Shamanistic Rage.     Increases all party and raid members' attack power by 10%.    Does not stack with other similar effects.

Name: Ancestral Spirit
Description: Returns the spirit to the body, restoring a dead target to life with 65 health and 120 mana.  Cannot be cast when in combat.

Name: Bind Elemental
Description: Binds the target hostile elemental for up to 50 sec. The bound unit is unable to move, attack or cast spells. Any damage caused will release the target. Only one target can be bound at a time.

Name: Chain Heal
Description: Heals the friendly target for 192 to 214, then jumps to heal additional nearby targets. If cast on a party member, the heal will only jump to other party members. Each jump reduces the effectiveness of the heal by 20%. Heals 3 total targets.

Name: Cleanse Spirit
Description: Cleanse the spirit of a friendly target, removing 1 poison effect, 1 disease effect, and 1 curse effect.

Name: Cleansing Totem
Description: Summons a Cleansing Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster that attempts to remove 1 disease and 1 poison effect from party members within 30 yards every 3 seconds.  Lasts 5 min.  This ability is usable while shapeshifted.

Name: Cloudburst Totem
Description: Summons a totem with 5 health for 15 sec that stores 30% of your Nature healing. When it expires or is recalled, it heals injured allies within 40 yards, divided evenly. Recasting the spell recalls the totem and releases the healing.

Name: Cure Toxins
Description: Cures 1 poison effect and 1 disease effect on a friendly target.

Name: Earth Shield
Description: Protects the target with an earthen shield. Lasts 10 min or 6 charges.     Attacks heal the shielded target for 53 (increased by 25% against monsters) and reduce casting or channel time lost when damaged by 34%.     This effect can only occur once every 3 seconds.    Earth Shield can only be placed on one target at a time.

Name: Earthliving Weapon
Description: Imbue your weapon with earthen life. Increases healing done by 26 and each direct heal has a 20% chance to proc Earthliving on the target, healing an additional 64 over 12 sec. This effect lasts for 2 hours.

Name: Healing Rain
Description: Calls forth healing rains to blanket the area, restoring health over time up to 5 party or raid members in a 10 yard area every 2 sec for 8 sec. This periodic effect can critically strike.

Name: Healing Stream Totem
Description: Summons a Healing Stream Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster for 5 min that heals group members within 30 yards for 6 every 2 seconds.  This ability is usable while shapeshifted.

Name: Healing Wave
Description: Heals a friendly target for 30 to 37.

Name: Lesser Healing Wave
Description: Heals a friendly target for 103 to 116.

Name: Mana Spring Totem
Description: Summons a Mana Spring Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster for 5 min that restores 16 mana every 5 seconds to all party and raid members within 30 yards.   Does not stack with other similar effects.  This ability is usable while shapeshifted.

Name: Mana Tide Totem
Description: Summons a Mana Tide Totem with 10% of the caster's health at the feet of the caster for 12 sec that restores 5% of total mana every 3 seconds to group members within 30 yards.  This ability is usable while shapeshifted.

Name: Nature's Swiftness
Description: When activated, your next Shaman Nature spell with a base casting time less than 10 sec. becomes instant and increases your cast speed by 10% for 20 sec. Does not stack with other similar cast speed increasing effects.

Name: Reincarnation
Description: Allows you to resurrect yourself upon death with 20% health and mana.    This has a 30 minute cooldown.

Name: Riptide
Description: Heals a friendly target for 117 to 126 and another 205 over 15 sec.  Your next Chain Heal cast on that primary target within 15 sec will consume the healing over time effect and increase the amount of the Chain Heal by 25%.

Name: Shaman Healing Mastery
Description: You gain Shaman Healing Mastery when learning any Shaman Healing Spell.     This Mastery automatically unlocks additional Shaman Healing Spells when you reach their Class Point requirements at no additional ability essence cost.   Healing Wave Heals a friendly target.   Lesser Healing Wave Heals a friendly target.

Name: Tidal Force
Description: Call upon the power of the Tides to empower your heals for 10 sec.  Healing Wave: Heals the target again for 30% of the original amount healed after 1 second.  Lesser Healing Wave: Increases your healing on the target by 5% for 8 seconds, stacks up to 3 times.  Chain Heal: No longer diminishes in healing with each jump.  Healing Rain: Duration is increased by 50%.

Name: Totemic Recall
Description: Returns your totems to the earth, giving you 50% of the mana required to cast each totem destroyed by Totemic Recall.  This ability is usable while shapeshifted.

Name: Tremor Totem
Description: Summons a Tremor Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster that shakes the ground around it, removing Fear, Charm and Sleep effects from party members within 30 yards.  Lasts 5 min.  This ability is usable while shapeshifted.

Name: Water Elemental Totem
Description: Summons an elemental totem that calls forth a greater water elemental to rain destruction on the caster's enemies. Lasts 2 min.    This ability is usable while shapeshifted.  This uses Fire Elemental Totem modifiers.

Name: Water Shield
Description: The caster is surrounded by 5 globes of water, granting 10 mana per 5 sec. When a spell, melee or ranged attack hits the caster, 40 mana is restored to the caster. This expends one water globe. Only one globe will activate every few seconds. Lasts 10 min.

Name: Water Totem Mastery
Description: You gain Water Totem Mastery when learning any Water Totem.     This Mastery automatically unlocks additional Water Totems when you reach their Class Point requirements at no additional ability essence cost.   Healing Stream Totem Places a Totem that heals allies around it.    Mana Spring Totem Places a Totem that provides mana regeneration to allies around it.    Fire Resistance Totem Places a Totem that provides Fire Resistance to allies around it.    Cloudburst Totem Places a Totem that stores Nature healing done to allies and after it expires this healing is dispersed amongst allies around it.    Mana Tide Totem Places a Totem that restores total mana to allies around it.    Cleansing Totem Places a Totem that removes disease and poisons from allies around it.    Water Elemental Totem Summons a water elemental that rains destruction on your enemies.

Name: Windwalk Totem
Description: Summons an Air Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster for 6 sec, granting party members within 10 yards Windwalk. Their movement speed is increased by 20% and cannot go below 100% speed while affected.    This ability is usable while shapeshifted.

Name: Ancestral Awakening
Description: When you critically heal with your Healing Wave, Lesser Healing Wave or Riptide you summon an Ancestral spirit to aid you, instantly healing the lowest percentage health friendly party or raid target within 40 yards for 30% of the amount healed.

Name: Ancestral Healing
Description: Reduces your target's Physical damage taken by 10% for 15 sec after getting a critical effect from one of your direct healing spells.   Does not stack with other similar effects.

Name: Blessing of the Eternals
Description: Increases your critical strike chance by 4%.    Increases the chance to apply the Earthliving heal over time effect on the target by 80% when they are at or under 50% total health.

Name: Focused Mind
Description: Reduces the duration of any Silence or Interrupt effects used against you by 30%. This effect does not stack with other similar effects.

Name: Healing Grace
Description: Increases your critical strike chance by 3%.    Reduces the chance your helpful Shaman spells and damage over time effects will be dispelled by 30%.    Capstone Bonus: All threat generated is reduced by 30%. This capstone effect does not stack with similar capstone effects.

Name: Healing Way
Description: Increases the amount healed by your Chain Heal, Earth Shield, Healing Rain, Healing Wave and Riptide by 25%.

Name: Improved Chain Heal
Description: Increases the amount healed by your Chain Heal spell by 20%.

Name: Improved Earth Shield
Description: Increases the amount of charges for your Earth Shield by 3.    Increases the healing done by your Earth Shield by 15%.  Capstone Bonus: Healing with Earth Shield grants you one stack of Tidal Waves. This effect can occur once every 5 seconds. This requires the final rank of Tidal Waves.

Name: Improved Healing Wave
Description: Increases the healing done by Healing Wave by 6% and critical strike chance by 3%.

Name: Improved Reincarnation
Description: Reduces the cooldown of your Reincarnation spell by 15 min and increases the amount of health and mana recovered when reincarnating by an additional 20%.

Name: Improved Water Shield
Description: Your Nature critical heals have a 30% and normal heals a 15% chance to restore mana as if you consumed a Water Shield Orb. This chance is doubled with Healing Wave.

Name: Natural Focus
Description: Increases your critical strike chance by 2%.    Reduces the pushback suffered from damaging attacks while casting by 70%.

Name: Nature's Blessing
Description: Increases your healing power by an amount equal to 12% of your Intellect.

Name: Nature's Guardian
Description: Increases your haste by 3%.     Capstone Bonus: Whenever a damaging non-periodic attack brings you below 30% health you are healed for a small amount (increased by healing power) and your next Nature spell is guaranteed to critically strike. Has a 30 second cooldown.

Name: Purification
Description: Increases the amount healed by your spells by 10%.

Name: Restorative Totems
Description: Increases the effect of your Mana Spring Totem by 20%, and increases the amount healed by your Healing Stream Totem by 45%.

Name: Tidal Focus
Description: Reduces the mana cost of your Shaman healing spells by 12%.

Name: Tidal Mastery
Description: Increases the critical effect chance of your Shaman healing spells, Lightning Bolt and Chain Lightning by 3% and reduces the cooldown of your Tidal Force by 18 seconds.  Capstone Bonus: Healing Wave and Riptide direct criticals add 2 seconds, Lesser Healing Wave 1 second and Chain Heal criticals 0.5 sec to the duration of Tidal Force.

Name: Tidal Waves
Description: Your Chain Heals and Riptides have a 100% chance to grant you Tidal Waves. reducing the cast time of your Healing Waves by 10% per charge and increases the critical effect chance of your Lesser Healing Waves by 10% per charge. Chain Heal grants three charges and Riptide grants two.   Your Healing Wave and Lesser Healing Wave spells gains an additional 12% of your bonus healing effects.

Name: Totemic Focus
Description: Reduces the mana cost of your totems by 50% and for every totem active, you gain 1 Haste and Critical Strike Rating.  This effect can stack up to 4 times and is increased per totem active.

Name: Corruption
Description: Corrupts the target, causing 28 Shadow damage over 12 sec.

Name: Curse Mastery
Description: You gain Curse Mastery when learning any Curse Spell.     This Mastery automatically unlocks additional Curse Spells when you reach their Class Point requirements at no additional ability essence cost.    Curse of Agony Curse an enemy, causing Shadow damage over time, this damage starts slowly and builds up over time.   Curse of Weakness Curse an enemy, reducing their attack power and armor.    Curse of Exhaustion Curse an enemy, reducing their movement speed.    Curse of Tongues Curse an enemy, reducing their casting speed.    Curse of the Elements Curse an enemy, reducing their magic resistance and increasing their magic damage taken.    Curse of Doom Curse an enemy, causing damage at the end of its duration, if the damage kills the target a Doomgaurd will be summoned.

Name: Curse of Agony
Description: Curses the target with agony, causing 36 Shadow damage over 24 sec.  This damage is dealt slowly at first, and builds up as the Curse reaches its full duration. Only one Curse per Warlock can be active on any one target.

Name: Curse of Doom
Description: Curses the target with impending doom, causing 1518 Shadow damage after 1 min. If the target yields experience or honor when it dies from this damage, a Doomguard will be summoned.      Cannot be cast on players.

Name: Curse of Exhaustion
Description: Reduces the target's movement speed by 30% for 12 sec.

Name: Curse of the Elements
Description: Curses the target for 5 min, reducing Arcane, Fire, Frost, Nature, and Shadow resistances by 45 and increasing magic damage taken by 8%.   Does not stack with other similar effects.

Name: Curse of Tongues
Description: Forces the target to speak in Demonic, increasing the casting time of all spells by 25%. Lasts 30 sec.    Lasts 12 seconds on players.   Does not stack with other similar effects.

Name: Curse of Weakness
Description: Target's attack power is reduced by 21 and armor is reduced by 5% for 2 min. Only one Curse per Warlock can be active on any one target.  Does not stack with other similar effects.

Name: Dark Pact
Description: Drains 221 of your summoned demon's mana, returning 100% to you.

Name: Death Coil
Description: Causes the enemy target to run in horror for 3 sec and causes 244 Shadow damage. The caster gains 300% of the damage caused in health.

Name: Drain Life
Description: Transfers 10 health every 1 sec from the target to the caster.  Lasts 5 sec.

Name: Drain Mana
Description: Transfers 3% of target's maximum mana every 1 sec from the target to the caster (up to a maximum of 6% of the caster's maximum mana every 1 sec).  Lasts 5 sec.

Name: Drain Soul
Description: Drains the soul of the target dealing 55 Shadow damage over 15 sec. Deals Four times damage to targets at or below 25% health.    If the target dies while being drained, and yields experience or honor, the caster gains a Soul Shard.  Each time the Drain Soul damages the target, it also has a chance to generate a Soul Shard.  Soul Shards are required for other spells.    Deals three times damage to players.

Name: Fear
Description: Strikes fear in the enemy, causing it to run in fear for up to 10 sec. (6 seconds on players). Damage caused may interrupt the effect. Only 1 target can be feared at a time.

Name: Haunt
Description: You send a ghostly soul into the target, dealing 212 to 250 Shadow damage and increasing all damage done by your Shadow damage-over-time effects on the target by 20% for 12 sec.    When the Haunt spell ends or is dispelled, the soul returns to you, healing you for 100% of the damage. (up to 20% of your Maximum Health).

Name: Howl of Terror
Description: Howl, causing 5 enemies within 10 yds to flee in terror for 6 sec. Damage caused may interrupt the effect.

Name: Life Tap
Description: Converts 15 health into 15 mana.  Spell power increases the amount of mana returned.

Name: Seed of Corruption
Description: Imbeds a demon seed in the enemy target, causing 480 Shadow damage over 18 sec.  When the target takes 0 total damage or dies, the seed will inflict 571 to 655 Shadow damage to all enemies within 15 yards of the target.

Name: Soul Swap
Description: You copy your damage-over-time effects from the target, preserving their power and duration.  For 5 sec afterwards, the next target you cast Soul Swap: Exhale on will be afflicted by the copied damage-over-time effects.  You cannot Soul Swap to the same target.

Name: Unstable Affliction
Description: Shadow energy slowly destroys the target, causing 550 damage over 15 sec.  In addition, if the Unstable Affliction is dispelled it will cause 990 damage to the dispeller and silence them for 5 sec. This spell benefits from haste.

Name: Amplify Curse
Description: Reduces the global cooldown of your Curses by 0.5 sec.

Name: Contagion
Description: Increases the damage of Curse of Agony, Corruption and Seed of Corruption by 6% and reduces the chance your helpful Affliction spells and damage over time effects  will be dispelled by an additional 30%.

Name: Death's Embrace
Description: Increases the amount drained by your Drain Life by 30% while your health is at or below 20% health.    Increases the damage done by your spells and abilities by 12% when your target is at or below 35% health.

Name: Empowered Corruption
Description: Increases the spell damage scaling of Corruption by 30%.

Name: Eradication
Description: When you deal damage with Corruption, you have 15% chance to increase your haste by 20% for 10 sec.

Name: Everlasting Affliction
Description: Increases the spell damage scaling of your Corruption and Unstable Affliction by 25%.    Direct shadow damage has a 100% chance to reset the duration of your Corruption spell on the target.

Name: Fel Concentration
Description: Increases haste by 2%.    Reduces the pushback suffered from damaging attacks while casting by 70%    Capstone Bonus: Your periodic magic damage heals you for 20% of the damage done while casting any damaging spell. (This heal cannot exceed 5% of your maximum health)

Name: Grim Reach
Description: Increases the range of your damaging spells with a channeling or cast time by 6 yards.     This does not stack with other similar effects.  Capstone Bonus: Dealing periodic Shadow damage to an enemy within melee range has a 33% chance to trigger a Grim Strike, dealing Shadow damage and reducing the target's melee attack power by 2 for 30 sec. Does not stack with other similar effects. This effect can only occur once every 15 sec.

Name: Improved Corruption
Description: Increases the damage done by your Corruption by 9%.    Increases the critical strike chance of your Seed of Corruption by 3%.

Name: Improved Curse of Agony
Description: Increases the damage done by your Curse of Agony by 10%.

Name: Improved Curse of Weakness
Description: Increases the amount of attack power reduced by your Curse of Weakness by 20%.

Name: Improved Drain Soul
Description: Returns 25% of your maximum mana if the target is killed by you while you drain its soul. The target must grant experience or honor.    Your Affliction spells generate 20% less threat.

Name: Improved Fear
Description: Your Fear inflicts a Nightmare on the target when the fear effect ends. The Nightmare effect reduces the target's movement speed by 30% for 2 sec.

Name: Improved Felhunter
Description: Your Felhunter regains 8% of its maximum mana each time it hits with its Shadow Bite ability and the cooldown on that ability is reduced by 4 sec.     In addition, the effect of your Felhunter's Fel Intelligence is increased by 10%.

Name: Improved Howl of Terror
Description: Reduces the cast time of Howl of Terror by 1.5 sec.

Name: Improved Life Tap
Description: Increases the effect of Life Tap by 20%.

Name: Malediction
Description: Increases all damage done by 3%.    Increases the periodic critical strike chance of your Corruption and Unstable Affliction spells by 15%.

Name: Nightfall
Description: Your shadow damage over time effects have a 8% chance for your next Shadow Bolt or Seed of Corruption spell becomes an instant cast and consumes 25% less mana.    This effect can only occur once every 5 sec.

Name: Pandemic
Description: Grants the periodic damage from your Corruption and Unstable Affliction spells the ability to critically hit.    Increases the damage of your Corruption, Unstable Affliction and Haunt by 20%.

Name: Shadow Embrace
Description: Direct damaging Shadow spells and abilities, Drain Life and Drain Soul apply Shadow Embrace, increasing all periodic Shadow damage you deal to the target by 5% and reducing all periodic healing and absorbs on the target by 5%. Lasts for 15 sec. Stacks up to 3 times.

Name: Shadow Mastery
Description: Increases the damage dealt or life drained by your Shadow spells by 6% and your Felhunter's Shadow Bite ability by 9%.

Name: Siphon Life
Description: When you deal damage with your Corruption spell, you are instantly healed for 20% of the damage done.     (Up to 5% of your Maximum Health).    Your Corruption, Seed of Corruption and Unstable Affliction damage over time effects are increased by 5%.

Name: Soul Siphon
Description: Increases the amount drained by your Drain Life and Drain Soul spells by an additional 6% for each of your Affliction effects on the target, up to a maximum of 18% additional effect.

Name: Suppression
Description: Increases your chance to hit with spells by 3%, and reduces the mana cost of your Affliction spells by 6%.

Name: Banish
Description: Banishes the enemy target, preventing all action but making it invulnerable for up to 20 sec. Only one target can be banished at a time. Casting Banish on a banished target will cancel the spell. Only works on Demons and Elementals.    Lasts 6 seconds on players.

Name: Blood Horror
Description: While channeling, encases yourself in a barrier of blood, making you immune to interrupts, silences and stuns. Any time an enemy within 15 yards deals non-periodic damage to you, you drain their health and cause them to run in horror for 4 sec.

Name: Create Firestone
Description: While applied to target weapon it increases damage dealt by spells by 1% and spell critical strike rating by 7. This effect lasts for 2 hours.     You can only benefit from one Warlock weapon enchant at a time.

Name: Create Healthstone
Description: Creates a Minor Healthstone that can be used to instantly restore 100 health.  Conjured items disappear if logged out for more than 15 minutes.  This ability is usable while shapeshifted.

Name: Create Soulstone
Description: Creates a Minor Soulstone. The Soulstone can be used to store one target's soul.  If the target dies while his soul is stored, he will be able to resurrect with 400 health and 700 mana.  Conjured items disappear if logged out for more than 15 minutes.

Name: Create Spellstone
Description: While applied to target weapon it increases damage dealt by periodic spells by 2% and spell haste rating by 7. This effect lasts for 2 hours.    You can only benefit from one Warlock weapon enchant at a time.

Name: Dark Apotheosis
Description: Your threat generated is significantly increased.    Teaches you Challenging Howl and Demon Claws.    Dark Apotheosis cannot cower behind a shield. Shields cannot be equipped while transformed.      Demon Claws 15 Rage Requires  Dark Apotheosis Strike twice, dealing 8 Physical damage per strike.   Challenging Howl 30 yd range 8 sec cooldown Taunts the target to attack you, but has no effect if the target is already attacking you.    Shares a cooldown with other single target taunt abilities and Distracting Shot. Can only be cast while in Dark Apotheosis.    This spell cannot miss and is automatically learned and unlearned with Dark Apotheosis.

Name: Demon Mastery
Description: You gain Demon Mastery when learning any Demon Spell.     This Mastery automatically unlocks additional Demon Spells when you reach their Class Point requirements at no additional ability essence cost.    Summon Imp Summons an Imp under the command of the Warlock.    Summon Voidwalker Summons a Voidwalker under the command of the Warlock.   Summon Succubus Summons a Succubus under the command of the Warlock.   Summon Felhunter Summons a Felhunter under the command of the Warlock.   Summon Felguard Summons a Felguard under the command of the Warlock.

Name: Demon Skin
Description: Protects the caster, increasing armor by 54, and healing received by 5%.    Does not stack with other similar effects.     Lasts until cancelled.

Name: Demonic Circle: Summon
Description: You summon a Demonic Circle at your feet, lasting 6 min. You can only have one Demonic Circle active at a time.

Name: Demonic Empowerment
Description: Grants the Warlock's summoned demon Empowerment.  Imp - Increases the Imp's spell critical strike chance by 20% for 30 sec.  Voidwalker - Increases the Voidwalker's health by 20%, and its threat generated from spells and attacks by 20% for 20 sec.  Succubus - Instantly vanishes, causing the Succubus to go into an improved Invisibility state. The vanish effect removes all stuns, snares and movement impairing effects from the Succubus.  Felhunter - Dispels all magical effects from the Felhunter.  Felguard - Increases the Felguard's attack speed by 20% and breaks all stun, snare and movement impairing effects and makes your Felguard immune to them for 15 sec.

Name: Demonic Leap
Description: Leap into the air upon demonic wings, moving a short distance. If you reactivate it within 1 sec you will leap again.

Name: Detect Invisibility
Description: Allows the friendly target to detect lesser invisibility for 10 min.  This ability is usable while shapeshifted.

Name: Enslave Demon
Description: Teaches you the necessary abilities to Enslave a Demon companion.  Teaches you Enslave Demon, Summon Demon, Dismiss Demon, Revive Demon and Demon Lore.      Enslave Demon Begins enslaving a demon to be your companion.     Your armor is reduced by 100% while you focus on taming the demon for 20 sec.     If you lose the demon's attention for any reason, the enslaving process will fail. Each type of demon has unique abilities that you will be able to make use of.

Name: Eye of Kilrogg
Description: Summons an Eye of Kilrogg and binds your vision to it. The eye moves quickly but is very fragile.  This ability is usable while shapeshifted.

Name: Fel Armor
Description: Surrounds you with fel energy, increasing spell power by 40 plus 30% of your Spirit.   Restores 2% of your max health every 5 sec.     Only one Armor spell can be active at a time. Lasts until cancelled.

Name: Fel Domination
Description: Your next Imp, Voidwalker, Succubus, Felhunter or Felguard Summon spell has its casting time reduced by 5.5 sec and its Mana cost reduced by 50%.

Name: Health Funnel
Description: Gives 12 health to the caster's pet every second for 10 sec as long as the caster channels.

Name: Inferno
Description: Summons a meteor from the Twisting Nether, causing 200 Fire damage and stunning all enemy targets in the area for 2 sec. An Infernal rises from the crater, under the command of the caster for 1 min.

Name: Metamorphosis
Description: You transform into a Demon for 30 sec.     This form grants you some unique demon abilities in addition to your normal abilities.     You may only use spells and abilities that deal Fire or Shadow damage(and spells usable while shapeshifted) in this form.    This form increases your armor from cloth and leather by 130%.    Increases your damage by 20%.    Reduces the chance you'll be critically hit by melee attacks by 6% and reduces the duration of stun and snare effects by 50%.

Name: Reign of Dread
Description: Surge into the air and scorch all enemies below with 95 to 115 Shadowflame damage over 2 sec.    Can be channeled while moving. While airborne, your movement speed is reduced by 25% and melee attacks against you have 60% increased chance to miss.

Name: Ritual of Doom
Description: Begins a ritual that sacrifices a random participant's health to summon a doomguard. Requires the caster and 4 additional party members to complete the ritual. In order to participate, all players must right-click the portal and not move until the ritual is complete.

Name: Ritual of Souls
Description: Begins a ritual that creates a Soulwell. Raid members can click the Soulwell to acquire a Major Healthstone. The Soulwell lasts for 3 min or 25 charges.     Requires the caster and 2 additional party members to complete the ritual. In order to participate, all players must right-click the soul portal and not move until the ritual is complete.

Name: Ritual of Summoning
Description: Begins a ritual that creates a summoning portal. The summoning portal can be used by 2 party or raid members to summon a targeted party or raid member.      The ritual portal requires the caster and 2 additional party or raid members to complete.     In order to participate, all players must be out of combat and right-click the portal and not move until the ritual is complete.     Cannot be used in High-Risk mode

Name: Shadow Ward
Description: Absorbs 290 Shadow damage. Lasts 30 sec.  This ability is usable while shapeshifted.

Name: Soul Conjuring Mastery
Description: You gain Conjuring Mastery when learning any Conjuring Spell.     This Mastery automatically unlocks additional Conjuring Spells when you reach their Class Point requirements at no additional ability essence cost.   Create Spellstone Creates a Spellstone that is can be applied to a weapon, increasing damage over time effects and provides spell haste rating.   Create Firestone Creates a Firestone that is can be applied to a weapon, increasing spell damage and provides spell critical strike rating.    Ritual of Summoning Begins a ritual that creates a summoning portal to summon a targeted party or raid member.

Name: Soul Harvest
Description: Increases your magic damage and your pets' damage by 15%. Lasts 6 sec, increased by 3 sec for each target afflicted by your Corruption, Curse of Agony, Immolate, Shadow Word: Pain and Devouring Plague, up to a maximum of 24 sec.   Does not stack with other similar effects.  This ability is usable while shapeshifted.

Name: Soul Link
Description: When active, 20% of all damage taken by the caster is taken by your Summoned or Enslaved Demon or your Ghoul summoned through Master of Ghouls. That damage cannot be prevented. Lasts as long as the linked pet is active, controlled and you are within 30 yards of it.

Name: Soulshatter
Description: Reduces threat by 50% for all enemies within 50 yards.

Name: Soulwell Mastery
Description: You gain Soulwell Mastery when learning any Soulwell Spell.     This Mastery automatically unlocks additional Soulwell Spells when you reach their Class Point requirements at no additional ability essence cost.    Create Healthstone Creates a Healthstone that can be used to restore health.   Ritual of Souls Begins a ritual that provides Healthstones to allies.

Name: Summon Felguard
Description: Summons a Felguard under the command of the Warlock.

Name: Summon Felhunter
Description: Summons a Felhunter under the command of the Warlock.

Name: Summon Imp
Description: Summons an Imp under the command of the Warlock.

Name: Summon Succubus
Description: Summons a Succubus under the command of the Warlock.

Name: Summon Voidwalker
Description: Summons a Voidwalker under the command of the Warlock.

Name: Summoner's Armor
Description: Empowers your tamed beast, tamed dragonkin, dominated undead, enslaved demon, summoned demon, wild imp or tethered elemental, increasing their critical strike chance with spells and abilities by 2% and their spell damage done by 3%.  Only one type of Warlock Armor spell can be active at any time.

Name: Temporary Enslaved Demon
Description: Enslaves the target demon, up to level 32, forcing it to do your bidding. While enslaved, the time between the demon's attacks is increased by 30% and its casting speed is slowed by 20%. Lasts up to 5 min.

Name: Unending Breath
Description: Allows the target to breathe underwater for 30 min.  This ability is usable while shapeshifted.

Name: Unending Resolve
Description: Hardens your skin, reducing all damage taken by 30% and preventing your spells from being interrupted or silenced for 6 sec.

Name: Warlock Armor Mastery
Description: You gain Warlock Armor Mastery when learning any Warlock Armor Spell.     This Mastery automatically unlocks additional Warlock Armor Spells when you reach their Class Point requirements at no additional ability essence cost.   Demon Skin Protects the caster, increasing armor and healing received.   Summoner's Armor Empowers your pet and wild imps, increasing their critical strike chance and their spell damage.    Fel Armor Surrounds you with fel energy, increasing spell damage and restores health over time.

Name: Burning Resolve
Description: Increases your Parry chance by 3% and Stamina by 3%.

Name: Decimation
Description: Dealing direct damage with Fire or Shadow spells to targets below 35% health reduces the cast time of Soul Fire by 40% and increases number of Wild Imps spawned by your Hand of Gul'dan is by 2 for 10 sec.    Soul Fires cast under the effect of Decimation cost no shard.

Name: Demon Hide
Description: Increases your maximum health while in Dark Apotheosis by 25%.

Name: Demonic Aegis
Description: Increases the effectiveness of your Demon Skin by 30%.    Increases the effectiveness of your Fel Armor by 30%.    Increases the armor contribution from cloth items while in Dark Apotheosis by 200%.

Name: Demonic Brutality
Description: Increases the effectiveness of your Voidwalker's Torment, Consume Shadows, Sacrifice and Suffering spells by 30%.    Increases the attack power bonus on your Felguard's Demonic Frenzy effect by 3%.

Name: Demonic Embrace
Description: Increases your total Stamina by 6%.

Name: Demonic Knowledge
Description: Increases your spell damage by an amount equal to 12% of the total of your active demon's Stamina plus Intellect.

Name: Demonic Pact
Description: Increases your spell damage done by 10%.    Your Summoned Demon's spell criticals increase spell power of yourself, party and raid members by 5% of your Spell Damage for 45 sec.    This effect has a 20 sec cooldown. Does not work on Enslaved demons.

Name: Demonic Resilience
Description: Reduces the chance you'll be critically hit by melee and spells by 6%.    Reduces all damage your summoned demon and dominated demon takes by 15%.

Name: Demonic Tactics
Description: Increases melee and spell critical strike chance for you, your tamed pet, and your Wild Imps by 10%.    Tamed Pet includes Summoned Demon, Enslave Demon, Dominate Undead, Tame Dragonkin, Tether Elemental, Summoned Ghoul, and Tame Beast.

Name: Fel Synergy
Description: You have a 100% chance to heal your pet for 15% of the amount of spell damage done by you.

Name: Fel Vitality
Description: Increases the Stamina and Intellect of your Imp, Voidwalker, Succubus, Felhunter and Felguard by 30%.    Increases your maximum health and mana by 3%.

Name: Improved Demon Skin
Description: Increases the healing received by Demon Skin by 5%.    Increases the armor given by your Demon Skin by 60%.

Name: Improved Demonic Tactics
Description: Increases your Wild Imps and tamed pet's critical strike chance equal to 30% of your spell critical strike chance.    Tamed Pet includes Summoned Demon, Enslave Demon, Dominate Undead, Tame Dragonkin, Tether Elemental, Summoned Ghoul, and Tame Beast.

Name: Improved Health Funnel
Description: Increases the amount of health transferred by your Health Funnel spell by 20%. and reduces the health cost by 20%.     Your summoned Demon takes 30% less damage while under the effect of your Health Funnel.

Name: Improved Healthstone
Description: Increases your stamina by 2%.    Increases the healing you take from healthstones by 20%.

Name: Improved Imp
Description: Increases the damage dealt by your Imp and Wild Imps by 30% and the effect of Fire Shield and Blood Pact by 20%.

Name: Improved Succubus
Description: Reduces the cast time of your Succubus' Seduction by 66%, and increases the duration of your Succubus' Seduction and Lesser Invisibility spells by 30%.

Name: Inner Demons
Description: Increases the healing received by Demon Skin by an additional 10%.    Increases the Stamina benefit of Demonic Embrace by 100%.

Name: Mana Feed
Description: When you gain mana from Drain Mana or Life Tap spells, your tamed pet gains 150% of the mana you gain.    Your tamed pet regenerates 6% of its missing mana every 5 sec.    Tamed Pet includes Summoned Demon, Enslave Demon, Dominate Undead, Tame Dragonkin, Tether Elemental, Summoned Ghoul, and Tame Beast.

Name: Master Conjuror
Description: Increases the combat ratings gained from your conjured Firestone and Spellstone by 300%.

Name: Master Demonologist
Description: Grants both the Warlock and the summoned demon an effect as long as that demon is active.  Imp - Increases your Fire damage by 5%, and increases the critical effect chance of your Fire spells by 5%.  Voidwalker - Reduces Physical damage taken by 10%.  Succubus - Increases your Shadow damage by 5%, and increases the critical effect chance of your Shadow spells by 5%.  Felhunter - Reduces all spell damage taken by 10%.  Felguard - Increases all damage done by 5%, and reduces all damage taken by 5%.  Enslaved Demons - Increases all damage done by 5%, and reduces all damage taken by 5%.

Name: Master Summoner
Description: Reduces the casting time of your Imp, Voidwalker, Succubus, Felhunter and Fel Guard Summoning spells by 4 sec and the Mana cost by 40%.    Increases the duration of your Infernal and Doomguard summons by 6 min and your Wild Imps from Hand of Gul'Dan by 5 sec.

Name: Molten Core
Description: Increases the duration of your Immolate by 9 sec. Dealing damage with Corruption has a 12% chance to grant you Molten Core.    Molten Core empowers your next 3 spells cast within 15 sec:    Incinerate - Increases damage done by 18% and reduces cast time by 30%.    Soul Fire - Increases damage done by 18% and increases critical strike chance by 15%.

Name: Nemesis
Description: Reduces the cooldown of your Demonic Empowerment, Metamorphosis, Inferno, Ritual of Doom, and Fel Domination spells by 30%, and the cooldown of your Demonic Leap by 15 seconds.  Capstone Bonus: While in Metamorphosis, your Hand of Gul'dan can be cast twice within 6 sec before going on cooldown.

Name: Shadowflame Claws
Description: While in Dark Apotheosis, your Shadow, Fire, and Physical spells and abilities deal 9% more damage and generate 30% more threat.

Name: Unholy Power
Description: Increases the damage done by your Voidwalker, Succubus, Felhunter and Felguard's melee attacks, your Imp's Firebolt and the Firebolt of your Wild Imps by 35%.     Increases the critical strike chance of your Hand of Gul'dan by 15%.

Name: Burning Rush
Description: Drains 5% of your maximum health every 2 seconds to increase your movement speed by 50%. This damage does not break crowd control effects.     Allows you to cast Fire spells while moving, and movement-impairing effects may not reduce you below 100% of normal movement speed. Lasts for 6 sec.

Name: Chaos Bolt
Description: Sends a bolt of chaotic fire at the enemy, dealing 518 Shadowflame damage. Chaos Bolt cannot be resisted, and pierces through all absorption, deflection, and reflection effects.

Name: Conflagrate
Description: Consumes an Immolate or Shadowflame effect on the enemy target to instantly deal damage equal to 60% of your Immolate or Shadowflame, and causes an additional 40% damage over 6 sec. This periodic damage may critically strike.

Name: Hand of Gul'dan
Description: Calls down a demonic meteor dealing Shadowflame damage to enemies within 5 yards and summons 4 Wild Imps which burst forth to attack the target for 10 sec.

Name: Hellfire
Description: Ignites the area surrounding the caster, causing 83 periodic Fire damage to herself and 83 periodic Fire damage to all nearby enemies every 1 sec. Lasts 15 sec.

Name: Immolate
Description: Burns the enemy for 8 Fire damage and then an additional 20 Fire damage over 15 sec.

Name: Incinerate
Description: Deals 100 to 118 Fire damage to your target and an additional 25 to 30 Fire damage if the target is affected by an Immolate spell.

Name: Rain of Fire
Description: Calls down a fiery rain to burn enemies in the area of effect for 480 Fire damage over 8 sec.

Name: Searing Pain
Description: Inflict searing pain on the enemy target, causing 30 to 37 Fire damage. Causes a high amount of threat.

Name: Shadow Bolt
Description: Sends a shadowy bolt at the enemy, causing 16 to 21 Shadow damage.

Name: Shadowburn
Description: Instantly blasts the target for 102 Shadowflame damage.     If the target dies within 5 sec of Shadowburn, and yields experience or honor, the caster gains a Soul Shard.

Name: Shadowflame
Description: Targets in a cone in front of the caster take 61 to 66 Shadowflame damage and an additional 64 Shadowflame damage over 8 sec.

Name: Shadowfury
Description: Shadowfury is unleashed, causing 208 to 245 Shadow damage and stunning all enemies within 8 yds for 3 sec.

Name: Soul Fire
Description: Burn the enemy's soul, causing 265 Fire damage.

Name: Abyssal Insight
Description: Increases your Spell penetration by 1, scaling with your level.

Name: Aftermath
Description: Increases the periodic damage done by your Immolate by 6%.    Your Conflagrate has a 100% chance to daze the target, reducing movement speed by 50% for 5 sec.

Name: Backdraft
Description: When you cast Conflagrate, Mind Blast, Shadowfury or Shadowburn, the cast or channel time of  your next 3 Shadow or Fire spells is reduced by 30%. Lasts 15 sec.     Increases the damage of your Shadowburn by 20%.

Name: Backlash
Description: Increases your critical strike chance by 3%.    You have a 25% chance when hit by a physical attack to reduce the cast time of your next Shadow Bolt or Incinerate spell by 100%. This effect lasts 12 sec.    Cannot occur more than once every 8 seconds.

Name: Bane
Description: Increases the critical strike chance of Shadow Bolt, Chaos Bolt, Immolate, Hand of Gul'dan, Soul Fire and Shadowflame by 6% and reduces the mana cost of these spells by 15%.

Name: Cataclysm
Description: Increases the damage of your Rain of Fire, Hellfire, Inferno, Hand of Gul'dan and Shadowfury by 18%.

Name: Demonic Power
Description: Reduces the cooldown of your Succubus' Lash of Pain spell by 6 sec.    Reduces the cast time of your Imp's Firebolt and the Firebolt of your Wild Imps by 0.5 sec, and increases their damage by 14%.

Name: Destructive Reach
Description: Increases the range of your damaging spells with a channeling or cast time by 6 yards.   This does not stack with other similar effects.  Capstone Bonus: Your spell critical strike chance is increased against enemies further than 20 yards from you by 4%.

Name: Devastation
Description: Increases the critical strike chance of your Destruction spells by 5%.

Name: Emberstorm
Description: Increases the damage done by your Fire and Shadow spells by 5%.

Name: Empowered Imp
Description: Increases the damage done by your Summoned Imp's Firebolt by 30% and critical strike damage bonus by 100%.    Your Imp's Firebolt critical strikes have a 100% chance to increase the spell critical strike chance of your next Warlock Destruction direct spell by 100%. This effect lasts 8 sec.

Name: Fire and Brimstone
Description: Increases the damage done by your direct fire spells with a cast time to targets afflicted by your Immolate by 10%.    Increases the critical strike chance of your Conflagrate spell by 25%.

Name: Improved Immolate
Description: Increases the damage done by your Immolate spell by 30%.

Name: Improved Searing Pain
Description: Increases the critical strike chance of your Searing Pain spell by 10%.

Name: Improved Shadow Bolt
Description: Increases the damage done by your Shadow Bolt spell by 15%.    Your Shadow Bolt has a 100% chance to cause your target to be vulnerable to spell damage, increasing spell critical strike chance against that target by 5%. Effect lasts 30 sec.   Does not stack with other similar effects.

Name: Improved Shadowburn
Description: Dealing damage with direct Shadow spells or abilities has a 30% chance to make your next Shadowburn not consume a Soul Shard and have 50% reduced cooldown.

Name: Improved Soul Leech
Description: Your Soul Leech effect also restores mana to you and your summoned demon equal to 4% of your missing mana, and has a 100% chance to grant Replenishment.    Replenishment Replenishes 1% of maximum mana per 5 sec on up to 10 party members for 15 sec.

Name: Intensity
Description: Increases all damage done by 2%.    Reduces spell pushback suffered from damaging attacks by 70%.

Name: Molten Skin
Description: When hit by a melee or ranged attack you have a 9% chance of increasing your Fire damage done by 10% for 10 sec.    Reduces all damage taken by your Hellfire by 30%.

Name: Nether Protection
Description: Gives you a 30% chance when being hit with a spell or taking periodic spell damage to gain Nether Protection, reducing all damage by that spell school by 10% for 6 sec. This effect can only occur once every 4 sec.

Name: Pyroclasm
Description: When you critically strike with Searing Pain, Scorch, or Conflagrate, your Fire and Shadow spell damage is increased by 6% for 10 sec.

Name: Ruin
Description: Your spell critical strikes now deal 200% damage.     This does not stack with other similar effects.  Capstone Bonus: Increases your Fire and Shadow damage done by 2%. This effect is quadrupled against targets above 75% health.

Name: Shadow and Flame
Description: Increases the spell damage scaling of your Shadow Bolt, Shadowburn, Chaos Bolt, Shadowfury, Soul Fire, Hand of Gul'dan, Incinerate and Shadowflame by 20%.

Name: Soul Leech
Description: Your direct Shadow damage and your Soul Fire, Incinerate, Searing Pain and Conflagrate spells have a 30% chance to heal you for 20% of the damage caused.    Returns up to a maximum of 15% of your health.

Name: Avatar
Description: Transform into an unstoppable colossus for 12 sec, causing you to deal 15% increased Physical damage and take 20% less damage.    While in this state you move at 80% speed which cannot be reduced or increased. You are also immune to immobilizing effects.

Name: Battle Stance
Description: A balanced combat stance that increases the armor penetration of all of physical attacks by 10%.

Name: Bladestorm
Description: Instantly Whirlwind up to 4 nearby targets and for the next 6 sec you will perform a whirlwind attack every 1 sec.  While under the effects of Bladestorm, you can move but cannot perform any other abilities but you do not feel pity or remorse or fear and you cannot be stopped unless disarmed or killed.

Name: Charge
Description: Charge an enemy, generate 12 rage, and root it for 1.50 sec.  This ability is usable while shapeshifted.

Name: Colossus Smash
Description: Smashes a target for 150% weapon damage, which ignores armor, to weaken their defenses, allowing your attacks to bypass 30% of their armor for 6 sec.

Name: Demoralizing Banner
Description: Throw down a war banner that decreases the armor of all enemies within 30 yards by 20% and their critical strike chance by 10%. Lasts 15 sec. Does not stack with other similar effects.  You can Intervene to your war banner.  This ability can be used while shapeshifted.

Name: Hamstring
Description: Attack the enemy for 3 damage and maims the enemy, reducing movement speed by 50% for 15 sec. Lasts 10sec vs players.

Name: Heroic Leap
Description: Leap through the air toward a target location, slamming down with destructive force to deal Physical damage and slow all enemies within 8 yards by 50% for 2 sec. While in the air you are immune to crowd control effects.  Usable while shapeshifted.

Name: Heroic Strike
Description: A strong attack that increases melee damage by 11 and causes a high amount of threat.

Name: Heroic Throw
Description: Throws your weapon at the enemy causing 18 damage (based on attack power).  This ability causes high threat.

Name: Mocking Blow
Description: A mocking attack, dealing weapon damage, that causes a moderate amount of threat and forces the target to focus attacks on you for 6 sec.

Name: Mortal Strike
Description: A vicious strike that deals 100% weapon damage plus 55 and wounds the target, reducing the effectiveness of any healing by 50% for 10 sec.   Does not stack with other similar effects.

Name: Overpower
Description: Instantly overpower the enemy, causing 100% weapon damage. Only usable after the target dodges. The Overpower cannot be blocked, dodged or parried.

Name: Rend
Description: Wounds the target causing them to bleed for 25 damage plus an additional 2 (based on weapon damage) over 15 sec.    While wielding a single Two-Handed weapon, this periodic damage can critically strike.

Name: Retaliation
Description: Instantly counterattack any enemy that strikes you in melee for 12 sec.  Melee attacks made from behind cannot be counterattacked.  A maximum of 20 attacks will cause retaliation.

Name: Shattering Throw
Description: Throws your weapon at the enemy causing 18 damage (based on attack power) and removing any invulnerabilities.     If no invulnerability is removed, you lower the target's armor by 20% for 10 seconds and reduce the cooldown of your next Shattering Throw by 30 seconds.

Name: Skull Banner
Description: Throw down a war banner at your feet that increases the melee and ranged critical strike chance of party or raid members within 40 yards of the banner by 20%. Lasts 10 sec.  Allies receiving this effect will become Fatigued and unable to benefit from Skull Banner for 3 min.  You can Intervene to your war banner.  This ability is usable while shapeshifted.

Name: Stance Mastery
Description: You gain Stance Mastery when learning any Stance Spell.     This Mastery automatically unlocks additional Stance Spells when you reach their Class Point requirements at no additional ability essence cost.    Battle Stance A balanced combat state that increases armor penetration while active.    Defensive Stance Increases armor, reduces damage taken and increases threat generation. Damage done and Healing done reduced.    Berserker Stance An aggressive stance that increases your Critical hit chance and increases damage taken.    Taunt Taunts an enemy target, forcing them to attack you.

Name: Sweeping Strikes
Description: While active, casting a melee ability that deals damage will cause a Sweeping Strike, dealing 40% weapon damage to 5 nearby enemies, further increased by attack power. Lasts 10 sec.    Can't be active at the same time as Blade Flurry.    This ability is usable while shapeshifted.

Name: Thunder Clap
Description: Blasts nearby enemies dealing 15 damage and increasing the time between their attacks by 10% for 10 sec. This ability causes additional threat.

Name: Anger Management
Description: Generates 6 rage per 3 seconds.

Name: Blood Frenzy
Description: Increases your melee attack speed by 10%.      Rend and Deep Wounds increase all Physical damage caused to that target by 4%.   Does not stack with similar effects.

Name: Deep Wounds
Description: Your melee critical strikes cause the opponent to bleed, dealing 48% of your melee weapon's average damage over 6 sec.    While wielding a single Two-Handed weapon, the periodic damage from Deep Wounds can critically strike.

Name: Deflection
Description: Increases your Parry chance by 3%.    Does not stack with other Deflection talents.

Name: Impale
Description: Increases the critical strike damage bonus of your Warrior abilities by 20%.

Name: Improved Charge
Description: Increases the amount of rage generated by your Charge ability by 10.

Name: Improved Hamstring
Description: Increases the damage of your Hamstring by 15%.  Capstone Bonus: Your Hamstring ability will immobilize the target for 3 sec. This effect cannot occur more than once every 10 sec.

Name: Improved Heroic Strike
Description: Increases the damage of your Heroic Strike by 9% and reduces the rage cost by 6.

Name: Improved Mortal Strike
Description: Increases the damage caused by your Mortal Strike ability by 10%, reduces the cooldown by 2 sec, and increases the healing reduction effect by 10%.

Name: Improved Overpower
Description: Increases the critical strike chance of your Overpower ability by 50%.

Name: Improved Rend
Description: Increases the bleed damage done by your Rend ability by 20%.

Name: Improved Slam
Description: Increases the damage of Slam by 20% and reduces its swing time by 1 sec.

Name: Iron Will
Description: Reduces the duration of all Stun and Charm effects used against you by 20%.  This does not stack with other Stun reduction effects.

Name: Juggernaut
Description: Following a Charge or Heroic Leap, you have a 100% chance for your next Slam to critically hit and your next Mortal Strike to apply Rend. (If learned)     Reduces the cooldown of Heroic Leap by 4 sec.

Name: Mace Specialization
Description: Increases your armor penetration by 30% while a mace is equipped.

Name: Poleaxe Specialization
Description: Increases your physical critical damage and melee physical critical strike chance while an Axe or Polearm is equipped in your main hand by 5%.

Name: Second Wind
Description: Whenever you are struck by a Stun or Immobilize effect you will generate 20 rage and 10% of your total health over 10 sec.

Name: Strength of Arms
Description: Increases your total Strength by 4%, Stamina by 2% and Expertise by 2.    After using Overpower, Slam or Execute your next Mortal Strike causes 10% extra damage and cost 5 less rage. Stacks up to 2 times.

Name: Sudden Death
Description: Your direct damaging attacks have a chance (greater than previous rank) of allowing the use of Execute regardless of the target's health state.    You keep at least 3 rage after using Execute.

Name: Sword Specialization
Description: Increases your chance to hit with spells and abilities by 5%.    Gives you a 10% chance to get an extra attack on the same target after hitting your target with your Sword dealing 120% weapon damage.     This damage is increased by 40% while wielding a single Two-Handed Weapon.

Name: Tactical Mastery
Description: Requires a Single Two-Handed or One-Handed Weapon.  Increases armor contribution from armor by 40% and increases the damage of Devastate by 25%.  Capstone Bonus: Stagger 30% of damage taken from attacks, distributing it over 10 seconds. This staggered damage does not break crowd control effects.  Does not work with Titan's Grip, Touched by the Light, or when Primary Stat is Spirit. Stagger is half as effective against players

Name: Taste for Blood
Description: Whenever your Rend ability causes damage, you have a 100% chance of allowing the use of your Overpower ability for 9 sec.     This effect will not occur more than once every 6 sec.

Name: Trauma
Description: Your melee critical strikes increase the effectiveness of Bleed effects on the target by 30% for 1 min.   Does not stack with other similar effects.

Name: Two-Handed Weapon Mastery
Description: You generate 25% more rage from damage dealt.  This effect is only active while wielding a single Two-Handed Weapon. (Does not work with Titan's Grip.)

Name: Two-Handed Weapon Specialization
Description: Increases the physical damage you deal with two-handed melee weapons by 6%.

Name: Unrelenting Assault
Description: Reduces the cooldown of your Overpower and Revenge abilities by 4 sec and increases the damage done by both abilities by 20%.    If you strike a player with Overpower while they are casting, their magical damage and healing will be reduced by 50% for 6 sec.

Name: Weapon Mastery
Description: Whenever one of your attacks is dodged or blocked you have a 50% chance to gain 2% critical strike chance for 8 sec, stacks up to 3 times.     Reduces the duration of all Disarm effects used against you by 30%.      This does not stack with other Disarm duration reducing effects.

Name: Wrecking Crew
Description: Your melee critical hits enrage you, increasing all damage caused by 10% for 12 sec.  This effect does not stack with Enrage or trigger Enrage effects.

Name: Battle Shout
Description: Increases the Strength and Agility of all raid and party members within 30 yards by 2. Lasts 30 min.   Does not stack with other similar effects.  This ability is usable while shapeshifted.

Name: Berserker Rage
Description: The warrior enters a berserker rage, removing and granting immunity to Fear, Sap and Incapacitate effects and generating extra rage when taking damage.  Lasts 10 sec.  This ability is usable while shapeshifted.

Name: Berserker Stance
Description: An aggressive stance. Critical hit chance is increased by 3% and all damage taken is increased by 5%.

Name: Bloodbath
Description: For the next 5 sec, causes your Physical melee abilities to deal 50 bleed damage over 5 sec and reduces the movement speed of the target by 30% for 3 sec.    This ability can be used while shapeshifted.

Name: Bloodthirst
Description: Instantly attack the target causing 7 damage. Each bleed applied by you increases the damage of Bloodthirst by 8%, up to a maximum of 40%. In addition, the next 3 successful melee attacks will restore 1% of max health. This effect lasts 8 sec. Damage is based on your attack power.  This ability is usable while shapeshifted.

Name: Challenging Shout
Description: Forces all enemies within 10 yards to focus attacks on you for 6 sec.

Name: Cleave
Description: A sweeping attack that does your weapon damage plus 13 to the target and his nearest ally.

Name: Commanding Shout
Description: Increases maximum health of all party and raid members within 30 yards by 266. Lasts 30 min.   Does not stack with other similar effects.  This ability is usable while shapeshifted.

Name: Death Wish
Description: When activated you become enraged, increasing your physical damage by 15% but increasing all damage taken by 5%. Lasts 30 sec.  This ability is usable while shapeshifted.

Name: Demoralizing Shout
Description: Reduces the attack power of all enemies within 10 yards by 35 for 30 sec.   Does not stack with other similar effects.  This ability is usable while shapeshifted.

Name: Enraged Regeneration
Description: You regenerate 30% of your total health over 10 sec.  This ability requires an Enrage effect, consumes all Enrage effects and prevents any from affecting you for the full duration.

Name: Execute
Description: Attempt to finish off a wounded foe, causing 65 damage and converting each extra point of rage into 2 additional damage (up to a maximum cost of 30 rage). Only usable on enemies that have less than 20% health.

Name: Heroic Fury
Description: Removes any movement impairing effects and refreshes the cooldown of your Intercept and Siegebreaker abilities.  This ability is usable while shapeshifted.

Name: Intercept
Description: Charge an enemy, causing 1 damage (based on attack power) and stunning it for 3 sec.    This ability is usable while shapeshifted.

Name: Intimidating Shout
Description: The caster shouts, causing up to 5 enemies within 8 yards to cower in fear for 8 seconds. The targeted enemy will be unable to move while cowering.  This ability is usable while shapeshifted.

Name: Piercing Howl
Description: Causes all enemies within 10 yards to be Dazed, reducing movement speed by 50% for 6 sec.  This ability is usable while shapeshifted.

Name: Pummel
Description: Pummel the target, interrupting spellcasting and preventing spells of that school from being cast for 4 sec.    This ability shares a cooldown with other interrupts.

Name: Raging Blow
Description: A mighty blow that deals 125% weapon damage from both melee weapons. Requires a weapon in the mainhand and off-hand to use.  Becoming Enraged enables one use of Raging Blow. You can store up to 2 charges.    Multiple Raging Blow! charges cannot be gained within the same global cooldown. Does not receive a charge from Wrecking Crew.

Name: Rampage
Description: Increases ranged and melee critical strike chance of all party and raid members within 100 yds by 5%.    Does not stack with other similar effects.

Name: Recklessness
Description: Your attack speed is increased by 30%, but all damage taken is increased by 10%. Your next 3 non-periodic Warrior abilities have an additional 100% to critically hit, 3 yards extra range and will cause you to charge toward your enemy if not in melee range already. Lasts for 8 sec.    Charges are not consumed versus monsters.    While active, the duration of stun and movement impairing effects on you is reduced by 50%.

Name: Shout Mastery
Description: You gain Shout Mastery when learning any Shout Spell.     This Mastery automatically unlocks Shout Spells when you reach their Class Point requirements at no additional ability essence cost.    Battle Shout Increases the Strength and Agility of allies.   Demoralizing Shout Reduces the attack power of enemies around you.   Commanding Shout Increasex Maximun health of your allies.

Name: Siegebreaker
Description: Use your full strength to slam the target with your weapon, dealing 150% weapon damage to up to 5 nearby enemies in a conal attack.  If the target is a player, it also knocks them back. Enemies the target collides with are knocked back slightly and take 150% weapon damage.

Name: Single-Minded Fury
Description: While a one-handed weapon is equipped in both hands, your Mortal Strike, Overpower and Slam deal 5% less damage but will trigger an additional attack with your off-hand weapon.   Cannot be used with daggers.

Name: Slam
Description: Slams the opponent, causing 100% weapon damage plus 9.

Name: Titan's Grip
Description: Allows you to wield a Two-Handed Axe, Mace, or Sword in each hand.    Also allows for a weapon or shield to be held in the off-hand while a Staff is equipped.    Physical damage dealt is reduced by 10%.    While a Staff is equipped in your main hand, your Magic damage and healing done are reduced by 10%.

Name: Victory Rush
Description: Instantly attack the target causing 5 damage.  Can only be used within 20 sec after you kill an enemy that yields experience or honor. Damage is based on your attack power.

Name: Warrior Strike Mastery
Description: You gain Warrior Strike Mastery when learning any Warrior Strike Spell.     This Mastery automatically unlocks Warrior Strike Spells when you reach their Class Point requirements at no additional ability essence cost.    Heroic Strike A strong attack that increases melee damage and causes extra threat.   Cleave A sweeping attack that attacks your target and their nearest ally.

Name: Whirlwind
Description: In a whirlwind of steel you attack up to 4 enemies within 8 yards, causing 100% weapon damag from both melee weapons to each enemy.

Name: Armored to the Teeth
Description: Increases your melee attack power by 3 for every 150 armor value you have.

Name: Blood Craze
Description: Regenerates 6% of your total Health over 6 sec after being the victim of a critical strike.

Name: Bloodsurge
Description: Increases the duration of Bloodbath by 3 sec.     Damaging spells and abilities have a 100% chance of making your next Bloodthirst cost no rage, trigger no cooldown, ignore 50% of the target's armor and refresh Bloodbath on the target.     This effect can only occur once every 6 sec.

Name: Booming Voice
Description: Increases the duration of your Battle Shout, Demoralizing Shout and Commanding Shout by 50% and increases their area of effect by 50%.     Increases the melee attack power reduction of your Demoralizing Shout by 20%.

Name: Brutal Pummel
Description: Pummel applies two stacks of Sunder Armor to the target. If used when you are below 35% health, Pummel also Pacifies the target for 1 sec, preventing them from attacking.     Capstone Bonus: Successfully interrupting an enemy with Pummel now also deals 4 damage (increased by attack power).    Sunder Armor Sunders the target's armor, reducing it by 4%. Stacks up to 5 times and lasts for 30 sec. Does not stack with other similar effects.

Name: Commanding Presence
Description: Battle Shout increases your Strength by 0 and Commanding Shout increases your Stamina by 0 for 1 |4hour:hrs;. These effects scale with your level.

Name: Cruelty
Description: Increases your melee and ranged critical strike chance by 5%.    Increases your total Strength by 5%.

Name: Dance of Death
Description: Increases your critical strike chance by 6% when your health is below 75%.    Capstone Bonus: Killing an enemy that grants experience or honor or using Siegebreaker will heal you for 205, increased by attack power and reset your Intercept cooldown.    This effect can only occur once every 5 sec.

Name: Dual Wield Mastery
Description: Increases your melee attack speed by 10%.    Increases the damage done by your off-hand weapon by 33%.  Does not stack with Dual Wield Specialization

Name: Enrage
Description: Increases your Physical damage by 10% and haste by 10% for 12 sec after using Bloodrage, Berserker Rage or Recklessness.  Capstone Bonus: This effect also trigger from being struck by a damaging attack while below 50% health. This effect can occur once every 5 seconds.

Name: Fervor
Description: Increases your hit chance by 3%.     Increases your critical strike chance by 3% while in Berserker Stance.

Name: Furious Attacks
Description: Your melee attacks have a chance to reduce all healing done to the target by 25% for 10 sec. This can stack up to 2 times. This occurs more often than Furious Attacks (Rank 1).  Does not stack with other similar effects.

Name: Improved Berserker Stance
Description: Berserker Stance now also increases your damage against targets below 35% health by 9%. This effect is doubled while Enrage is active.  Capstone Bonus: Raging Blow increases the duration of your Recklessness by 1 second.

Name: Improved Cleave
Description: Increases the bonus damage done by your Cleave ability by 120%.

Name: Improved Execute
Description: Reduces the rage cost of your Execute ability by 6.

Name: Improved Intercept
Description: Reduces the cooldown of your Intercept ability by 10 sec.

Name: Improved Victory Rush
Description: Increases the critical strike chance of your Victory Rush by 60% and gives you a 100% when you parry to allow the use of Victory Rush for 10 sec.     This effect may only occur once every 12 seconds.

Name: Improved Whirlwind
Description: Increases the damage of your Whirlwind ability by 20%.

Name: Intensify Rage
Description: Reduces the cooldown of your Bloodrage, Recklessness and Death Wish abilities by 33%.

Name: Raging Berserker
Description: Using Berserker Rage or Heroic Fury will generate 50 rage. If used while below 50% health, your melee abilities are empowered for 5 sec, causing them to drain life from targets hit.

Name: Sharpened Edges
Description: Armored to the Teeth now increases attack power for every 108 armor instead of every 150.

Name: Shredding Blows
Description: Direct melee and ranged critical strikes increase your armor penetration by 24% for your next 3 attacks.

Name: Sidearm Specialization
Description: Increases your armor penetration by 18% and your hit chance by 3%.  Capstone Bonus: All threat generated is reduced by 30%. This capstone effect does not stack with similar capstone effects

Name: Unbridled Wrath
Description: Gives you a chance to generate 2 additional rage points when you deal melee damage with a weapon.

Name: Unending Fury
Description: Increases your damage done by 9%.  Capstone Bonus: While Bloodrage is active Fear effect durations are reduced by 30%.

Name: Bloodrage
Description: Generates 20 rage at the cost of health, and then generates an additional 10 rage over 10 sec.    This ability is usable while shapeshifted.

Name: Concussion Blow
Description: Stuns the opponent for 5 sec and deals 5 damage. (based on attack power).     Causes a High amount of threat.

Name: Defensive Stance
Description: Significantly Increases your threat generation.    Increases your armor by 10% and decreases damage taken by 10%.    Your damage and healing done is decreased by 5%.     Teaches you Taunt.

Name: Devastate
Description: Sunder the target's armor causing the Sunder Armor effect. In addition, causes 120% weapon damage (96% if a two-handed weapon is equipped) plus 4 for each application of Sunder Armor on the target. The Sunder Armor effect can stack up to 5 times.    Sunder Armor Sunders the target's armor, reducing it by 4%. Stacks up to 5 times and lasts for 30 sec. Does not stack with other similar effects.

Name: Disarm
Description: Disarm the enemy, removing their weapons, shields, or other equipment for 6 sec.

Name: Intervene
Description: Run at high speed towards a party or raid member, intercepting the next melee or ranged attack made against them and taunts up to 3 enemies attacking the target to attack you instead.

Name: Last Stand
Description: When activated, this ability temporarily grants you 30% of your maximum health for 20 sec.  After the effect expires, the health is lost.    This ability is usable while shapeshifted.

Name: Revenge
Description: Instantly counterattack an enemy for 88 to 107 damage.  Revenge is only usable after the warrior blocks, dodges or parries an attack.

Name: Shield Bash
Description: Bash the target with your shield dazing them and interrupting spellcasting, which prevents spells of that school from being cast for 6 sec.     This ability shares a cooldown with other interrupts.

Name: Shield Block
Description: Increases your chance to block and block value by 100% for 10 sec.

Name: Shield Slam
Description: Slam the target with your shield, causing 294 to 307 damage, modified by your shield block value, and dispels 1 magic effect on the target. Causes a high amount of threat.

Name: Shield Wall
Description: Reduces all damage taken by 60% for 12 sec.

Name: Shockwave
Description: Sends a wave of force in front of the caster, causing 6 damage (based on attack power) and stunning all enemy targets in a frontal cone for 4 sec.

Name: Spell Reflection
Description: Raise your shield, reflecting the next spell cast on you. Lasts 5 sec.

Name: Vigilance
Description: Focus your protective gaze on a group or raid target to reduce their damage taken by 3% and transfer 15% of the threat they cause to you.    Each time they are hit by an attack your Taunt and Growl cooldown is refreshed. Lasts 30 min. This effect can only be on one target at a time.

Name: Anticipation
Description: Increases your dodge chance by 5%.    Does not stack with other Anticipation talents.

Name: Critical Block
Description: Your successful blocks now further reduce the damage you take from the blocked hit by 25%. This effect does not work against players.     Increases your chance to critically hit with your Shield Slam ability by 10%.  Does not work with Touched by the Light.

Name: Damage Shield
Description: Whenever you take direct damage from or block a melee attack you cause damage equal to 20% of your block value.

Name: Defensive Mindset
Description: Leaving Defensive Stance no longer applies the Defensive Mindset debuff.

Name: Firm Grip
Description: Increases your armor value from your equipped Shield by 30%.    Increases your Stamina by 3%.    Increases your block value by 6%.

Name: Focused Rage
Description: Reduces the rage cost of your abilities by 3.  Capstone Bonus: You gain 5 Rage every time the target of your Vigilance takes damage. This effect can only occur once every second.|r

Name: Gag Order
Description: Gives your Shield Bash and Heroic Throw a 100% chance to silence the target for 3 sec.     Increases the damage of your Shield Slam ability by 10%.

Name: Improved Bloodrage
Description: Increases the rage generated by your Bloodrage ability by 50%.    While in Defensive Stance your Bloodrage reduces your damage taken by 4%.

Name: Improved Defensive Stance
Description: Reduces the chance you'll be critically hit by melee and spells by 6%.    When you Block, Parry or Dodge an attack you have a 100% chance to become Enraged, increasing Physical damage caused by 6% for 12 sec.

Name: Improved Disarm
Description: Reduces the cooldown of your Disarm ability by 20 sec and causes the target to take an additional 10% damage while disarmed.

Name: Improved Disciplines
Description: Reduces the cooldown of your Shield Wall, Retaliation, Avatar, and Recklessness abilities by 60 sec.

Name: Improved Revenge
Description: Increases damage of your Revenge ability by 30% and causes Revenge to strike an additional 2 target.     After using Revenge your next Devastate within 8 sec will strike an additional target.

Name: Improved Spell Reflection
Description: Reduces the chance you'll be hit by spells by 4% and when the ability is used it will reflect the first spell cast against the 4 closest party members within 20 yards.

Name: Improved Thunder Clap
Description: Reduces the cost of your Thunder Clap ability by 12 rage points and increases the damage by 30% and the slowing effect by an additional 10%.

Name: Incite
Description: Increases the critical strike chance of your Heroic Strike, Thunder Clap and Cleave abilities by 15%.

Name: One-Handed Weapon Specialization
Description: Increases Physical damage you deal when a one-handed melee weapon is equipped by 10%.

Name: Puncture
Description: Reduces the rage cost of your Devastate ability by 3.    Your attacks ignore an additional 12% of your target's armor.

Name: Resolve
Description: Increases your Strength by 6%, Stamina by 9% and your Expertise by 6.

Name: Safeguard
Description: Reduces damage taken by the target of your Intervene ability by 30% for 6 sec.

Name: Shield Mastery
Description: Increases your block value by 30% and reduces the cooldown of your Shield Block ability by 20 sec.

Name: Shield Specialization
Description: Increases your chance to block attacks with a shield by 10%.    You have a 100% chance to generate 5 rage when a block, dodge, or parry occurs.

Name: Sword and Board
Description: Increases the critical strike chance of Devastate by 15%.    Casting an ability that costs rage has a 30% chance to reset the cooldown of Shield Slam, make it cost no rage and increase its damage by 10%.

Name: Thunderstruck
Description: Increases the damage of Shockwave and Thunder Clap by 36%.

Name: Warbringer
Description: Your Charge, Intercept, and Intervene abilities have a 100% chance to remove all slowing effects when used.
